mcqs.explanation: 404 Not Found.

mcqs.question: Which of the following is not correct?

options.a: a) Web cache doesnt has its own disk space
options.b: b) Web cache can act both like server and client
options.c: c) Web cache might reduce the response time
options.d: d) Web cache contains copies of recently requested objects

mcqs.answer: a) Web cache doesnt has its own disk space
mcqs.explanation: Web cache or also known as HTTP cache is a temporary storage where HTML pages and images are stored temporarily so that server lag could be reduced.

mcqs.question: The conditional GET mechanism

options.a: a) Imposes conditions on the objects to be requested
options.b: b) Limits the number of response from a server
options.c: c) Helps to keep a cache upto date

mcqs.answer: c) Helps to keep a cache upto date
mcqs.explanation: The HTTP protocol requests the server of the website its trying to access so that it can store its files, images etc. in cache memory. This request of asking the server for a document considering a specific parameter is called conditional GET Request.

mcqs.question: Which of the following is present in both an HTTP request line and a status line?
mcqs.explanation: Status line is the the start line of an HTTP response. It contains the information such as the protocol version, a status text, status code.

links.context: This set of Computer Networks Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “HTTP & FTP”.

mcqs.question: Multiple objects can be sent over a TCP connection between client and server in a persistent HTTP connection.
mcqs.explanation: Persistent connections are kept active after completing transaction so that multiple objects can be sent over the same TCP connection.

mcqs.question: HTTP is ________ protocol.
mcqs.explanation: HTTP is an Application layer protocol used to define how messages are formatted and transmitted through the World Wide Web.

mcqs.question: In the network HTTP resources are located by
mcqs.explanation: The Uniform Resource Identifier is a name and locator for the resource to be located by the HTTP. The URLs and URNs are derived through the identifier.

mcqs.question: HTTP client requests by establishing a __________ connection to a particular port on the server.
mcqs.explanation: HTTP clients perform requests using a TCP connection, because the TCP connection provides a more reliable service. UDP is not a reliable protocol, border gateway protocol is used on top of TCP, while domain host control protocol is a network layer protocol.

mcqs.question: In HTTP pipelining ________________

options.a: a) multiple HTTP requests are sent on a single TCP connection without waiting for the corresponding responses
options.b: b) multiple HTTP requests can not be sent on a single TCP connection
options.c: c) multiple HTTP requests are sent in a queue on a single TCP connection
options.d: d) multiple HTTP requests are sent at random on a single TCP connection

mcqs.answer: a) multiple HTTP requests are sent on a single TCP connection without waiting for the corresponding responses
mcqs.explanation: HTTP pipelining helps the client make multiple requests without having to waiting for each response, thus saving a lot of time and bandwidth for the client.

mcqs.question: FTP server listens for connection on port number ____________
mcqs.explanation: Port 20 is used for FTP data. Port 22 is used for SSH remote login. Port 23 is used for TELNET.

mcqs.question: In FTP protocol, client contacts server using ____ as the transport protocol.
mcqs.explanation: The clients use the Transmission Control Protocol for FTP as it’s more reliable than UDP, DCCP, and SCTP, and reliability of file transfer is required to be as high as possible for FTP.

mcqs.question: In Active mode FTP, the client initiates both the control and data connections.
mcqs.explanation: In Passive mode of FTP, the client initiates both data and control connections, while in Active mode, the client initiates the control connection and then the server initiates the data connection.

mcqs.question: The File Transfer Protocol is built on ______________
mcqs.explanation: The FTP connection includes a Server and a Client which wish to share files. The server can have multiple clients at the same time while the client communicates with only one server at a time.

mcqs.question: In File Transfer Protocol, data transfer cannot be done in ___________
mcqs.explanation: In Stream mode, the data is transferred in a continuous stream. In Block mode, data is transferred after being divided into smaller blocks. In Compressed mode, data is transferred after being compressed using some compression algorithm.

links.context: This set of Computer Networks Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “FTP”.

mcqs.question: Expansion of FTP is __________
mcqs.explanation: File Transfer Protocol is an application layer protocol used to share “files” between a server and a client. The protocol uses two separate ports for data and control connections: port 20 for data and port 21 for control.

mcqs.question: FTP is built on _____ architecture.
mcqs.explanation: An FTP connection includes a Server and a Client which wish to share a number of data files. The server can transfer files with multiple clients at the same time while the client communicates with only one server at a time.

mcqs.question: FTP uses _________ parallel TCP connections to transfer a file.
mcqs.explanation: Control connection using FTP port: 21, and data connection using FTP port: 20. The FTP session is started or ended using port 21 and the actual data i.e. files are sent through port 20.

mcqs.question: Identify the incorrect statement regarding FTP.

options.a: a) FTP stands for File Transfer Protocol
options.b: b) FTP uses two parallel TCP connections
options.c: c) FTP sends its control information in-band
options.d: d) FTP sends exactly one file over the data connection

mcqs.answer: c) FTP sends its control information in-band
mcqs.explanation: FTP is out-of-band because the data connection is done separately through port 20 and control connection is done separately through port 21.

mcqs.question: If 5 files are transferred from server A to client B in the same session. The number of TCP connections between A and B is _______
mcqs.explanation: The client would first initiate the TCP control connection through port 21. Then for every file transfer, a separate connection would be made through port 20. Now, since we have five files to be transferred, 1 control connection + 5 data connections = 6 total TCP connections.

mcqs.question: FTP server _____________

options.c: c) Has single TCP connection for a file transfer
options.d: d) Has UDP connection for file transfer

mcqs.explanation: FTP server maintains state information of every control connection to keep track of the active and inactive connections in the session. This helps the server decide which connection to terminate, in case the connection is inactive for too long.

mcqs.question: The commands, from client to server, and replies, from server to client, are sent across the control connection in ________ bit ASCII format.
mcqs.explanation: FTP was designed to transmit commands only in English characters that are possible with just 7 bits in ASCII. Even the media has to be converted to ASCII before transmission.

mcqs.question: Find the FTP reply whose message is wrongly matched.
mcqs.explanation: The correct response code for the message “Can’t open data connection” is 425. Response code 452 is sent usually when the connection is suddenly closed.

mcqs.question: The data transfer mode of FTP, in which all the fragmenting has to be done by TCP is ________
mcqs.explanation: Stream mode is the default mode of FTP, in which the TCP transforms/fragments the data into segments, and then after the transmission is completed, converts it back to stream of bytes.

mcqs.question: The password is sent to the server using ________ command.
mcqs.explanation: The PASS command, preceded by the username, completes the user’s identification for access control in an FTP session. Without the valid password, the user won’t be able to initiate the FTP connection.

links.context: This set of Computer Networks Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “SMTP – 1”.

mcqs.question: When the mail server sends mail to other mail servers it becomes ____________
mcqs.explanation: SMTP clients are the entities that send mails to other mail servers. The SMTP servers cannot send independent mails to other SMTP servers as an SMTP server. There are no masters or peers in SMTP as it is based on the client-server architecture.

mcqs.question: If you have to send multimedia data over SMTP it has to be encoded into _______
mcqs.explanation: Since only 7-bit ASCII codes are transmitted through SMTP, it is mandatory to convert binary multimedia data to 7-bit ASCII before it is sent using SMTP.

mcqs.question: Expansion of SMTP is ________
mcqs.explanation: SMTP or Simple Mail Transfer Protocol is an application layer protocol used to transport e-mails over the Internet. Only 7-bit ASCII codes can be sent using SMTP.

mcqs.question: In SMTP, the command to write receiver’s mail address is written with the command _______
mcqs.explanation: RCPT TO command is followed by the recipient’s mail address to specify where or to whom the mail is going to through the internet. If there is more than one receiver, the command is repeated for each address continually.

mcqs.question: The underlying Transport layer protocol used by SMTP is ________
mcqs.explanation: TCP is a reliable protocol, and Reliability is a mandatory requirement in e-mail transmission using SMTP.

mcqs.question: Choose the statement which is wrong incase of SMTP?

options.a: a) It requires message to be in 7bit ASCII format
options.b: b) It is a pull protocol
options.c: c) It transfers files from one mail server to another mail server
options.d: d) SMTP is responsible for the transmission of the mail through the internet

mcqs.answer: b) It is a pull protocol
mcqs.explanation: In SMTP, the sending mail server pushes the mail to receiving mail server hence it is push protocol. In a pull protocol such as HTTP, the receiver pulls the resource from the sending server.

mcqs.question: Internet mail places each object in _________

options.a: a) Separate messages for each object
options.c: c) Varies with number of objects
options.d: d) Multiple messages for each object

mcqs.explanation: It places all objects into one message as it wouldn’t be efficient enough if there are different messages for each object. The objects include the text and all the multimedia to be sent.

mcqs.question: Typically the TCP port used by SMTP is _________
mcqs.explanation: The ports 15, 35 and 50 are all UDP ports and SMTP only uses TCP port 25 for reliability.

mcqs.question: A session may include ________

options.a: a) Zero or more SMTP transactions
options.c: c) Always more than one SMTP transactions
options.d: d) Number of SMTP transactions cant be determined

mcqs.answer: a) Zero or more SMTP transactions
mcqs.explanation: An SMTP session consists of SMTP transactions only even if no transactions have been performed. But no transactions in the session might mean that the session is inactive or is just initiated.

mcqs.question: Which of the following is an example of user agents for e-mail?
mcqs.explanation: Among the options, only Microsoft Outlook is an e-mail agent. Google is a search engine and Facebook, and Tumblr are social networking platforms. Gmail and Alpine are some other examples of e-mail agent.

mcqs.question: When the sender and the receiver of an email are on different systems, we need only _________

options.c: c) Two UAs and one MTA
options.d: d) Two UAs and two MTAs

mcqs.answer: d) Two UAs and two MTAs
mcqs.explanation: The sender’s User Agent (UA) submits the message to a Message Transfer Agent (MTA). Then the MTA sends the message to another MTA i.e. a mail relay. Then the receiver receives the message from the mail relay whenever it is available.

mcqs.question: User agent does not support this ___________
mcqs.explanation: The user agent is basically a software program that allows the user to send, and receive e-mail messages. Routing of the message is done by the Message Transfer Agent.

links.context: This set of Computer Networks Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “SMTP – 2”.

mcqs.question: Simple mail transfer protocol (SMTP) utilizes _________ as the transport layer protocol for electronic mail transfer.
mcqs.explanation: Since TCP is a reliable protocol, it’s more efficient to use TCP protocol for e-mail transfer. TCP also provides more security than other transport layer protocols.

mcqs.question: SMTP connections secured by SSL are known as _____________
mcqs.explanation: SSMTP is a simple mail transfer program to send mail from a local PC to a mail host. SNMP is a network management protocol. STARTTLS connections are secured by TLS.

mcqs.question: SMTP uses which of the following TCP port?
mcqs.explanation: Port 21 is used for FTP control connection, port 22 is used by SSH, and port 23 is used by TELNET.

mcqs.question: Which of the following protocol is not used to receive mail messages?
mcqs.explanation: FTP is used to share files. SMTP, POP and IMAP are the protocols used to send and receive mails on the internet.

mcqs.question: What is on-demand mail relay (ODMR)?

options.d: d) protocol for faster mail transfer

mcqs.explanation: ODMR is an extension to SMTP, in which mails are relayed to the receivers after they are authenticated. It allows only the authorized receivers to receive the mail.

mcqs.question: An email client needs to know the _________ of its initial SMTP server.
mcqs.explanation: The client needs to know the IP of its initial SMTP server as it has to send the mail first to that server and then the server forwards the mail ahead on behalf of the user.

mcqs.question: An SMTP session may not include _______

options.c: c) more than one SMTP transaction

mcqs.explanation: An SMTP session can only include SMTP transactions regardless the number. Any other protocol’s transaction is not included in an SMTP session.

mcqs.question: SMTP defines _______
mcqs.explanation: As the name suggests, Simple Mail Transfer Protocol is only responsible for “how” the message is transferred i.e. Transport of the message. Other protocols such as TCP are used to provide other services like encryption for the messages.

mcqs.question: Which one of the following is an SMTP server configured in such a way that anyone on the internet can send e-mail through it?
mcqs.explanation: Anyone can send an e-mail through an Open Mail Relay server so it acted like a free relay for email agents to forward their mails through. Open Mail Relays are now unpopular because they can be used by attackers to perform man-in-the-middle attacks.

mcqs.question: SMTP is not used to deliver messages to ______
mcqs.explanation: SMTP can only be used to send messages to user’s terminal, email client or mailbox. A stand-alone word processor cannot be connected to a network, so it won’t be possible to deliver messages to it.

links.context:
This set of Computer Networks Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “DNS”.

Essential Pre-read for this Topic: Domain Name System (DNS)

mcqs.question: The entire hostname has a maximum of ___________
mcqs.explanation: An entire hostname can have a maximum of 255 characters. Although each label must be from 1 to 63 characters long. Host name is actually a label that is given to a device in a network.

mcqs.question: A DNS client is called _________
mcqs.explanation: DNS client also known as DNS resolver also known as DNS lookup helps to resolve DNS requests using an external DNS server.

mcqs.question: Servers handle requests for other domains _______

options.b: b) by contacting remote DNS server

mcqs.answer: b) by contacting remote DNS server
mcqs.explanation: Whenever a request is received at server from other domains, it handles this situation by contacting remote DNS server.

mcqs.question: DNS database contains _______
mcqs.explanation: Domain Name system not only deals with mapping IP addresses with the hostname but also deals with exchange of information in the server.

mcqs.question: If a server has no clue about where to find the address for a hostname then _______

options.a: a) server asks to the root server
options.b: b) server asks to its adjcent server

mcqs.answer: a) server asks to the root server
mcqs.explanation: Root name servers are actually very important and critical as they are the first step in translating human readable hostnames into IP addresses for carrying out communication.

mcqs.question: Which one of the following allows client to update their DNS entry as their IP address change?
mcqs.explanation: Dynamic DNS or in short DDNS or DynDNS helps in automatically updating a name server in the DNS. This does not require manual editing.

mcqs.question: Wildcard domain names start with label _______
mcqs.explanation: A wildcard DNS record matches requests to a non existent domain name. This wildcard DNS record is specified by using asterisk “*” as the starting of a domain name.

mcqs.question: The right to use a domain name is delegated by domain name registers which are accredited by _______

options.d: d) internet corporation for assigned names and numbers

mcqs.answer: d) internet corporation for assigned names and numbers
mcqs.explanation: The ICANN (Internet Corporation for Assigned Names and Numbers) deals with IP address space allocation, protocol identifier assignment, generic and country code Top Level domain name system management (gTLD and ccTLD).

mcqs.question: The domain name system is maintained by _______
mcqs.explanation: A domain name system is maintained by a distributed database system. It is a collection of multiple, logically interrelated databases distributed over a computer network.

mcqs.question: Which one of the following is not true?

options.a: a) multiple hostnames may correspond to a single IP address
options.b: b) a single hostname may correspond to many IP addresses
options.c: c) a single hostname always corresponds to a single IP address

mcqs.answer: c) a single hostname always corresponds to a single IP address
mcqs.explanation: A single hostname does not always correspond to a single IP address. In many cases, a hostname can be associated with multiple IP addresses, such as in load balancing or Content Delivery Networks (CDNs). However, multiple hostnames can map to a single IP, and a hostname can have multiple IPs.

links.context: This set of Computer Networks Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “SSH”.

mcqs.question: Secure shell (SSH) network protocol is used for __________
mcqs.explanation: SSH provides high encryption and security features while communicating through a network. It is a cryptographic network protocol.

mcqs.question: SSH can be used in only _____________

options.c: c) both unix-like and windows systems

mcqs.answer: c) both unix-like and windows systems
mcqs.explanation: SSH isn’t confined to a certain network or operating system. It can be implemented over different networks and on different operating systems.

mcqs.question: SSH uses ___________ to authenticate the remote computer.

options.c: c) any of public-key or private-key

mcqs.explanation: Public encryption key is slower but more flexible. Every cryptographic security system requires a private key for private access and a public key for location.

mcqs.question: Which standard TCP port is assigned for contacting SSH servers?
mcqs.explanation: Port 22 is used for contacting ssh servers, used for file transfers (scp, sftp) and also port forwarding.

mcqs.question: Which one of the following protocol can be used for login to a shell on a remote host except SSH?
mcqs.explanation: SSH is more secured then telnet and rlogin.

mcqs.question: Which one of the following is a file transfer protocol using SSH?
mcqs.explanation: SCP (Secure copy protocol), SFTP (SSH File Transfer Protocol) and Rsync all are file transfer protocols which are used by SSH.

mcqs.question: SSH-2 does not contain ______________
mcqs.explanation: SSH2 is a more secure, portable and efficient version of SSH that includes SFTP, which is functionally similar to FTP, but is SSH2 encrypted.

mcqs.question: Which one of the following feature was present in SSH protocol, version 1?

options.b: b) periodic replacement of session keys

mcqs.explanation: All of the mentioned features are provided by SSH-2 and that SSH-1 only provide strong authentication and guarantee confidentiality.

mcqs.question: SCP protocol is evolved from __________ over SSH.
mcqs.explanation: RCP is the abbreviation for Rate Control Protocol is a congestion control algorithm for fast user response times.

mcqs.question: Which one of the following authentication method is used by SSH?
mcqs.explanation: SSH used public key authentication, Password authentication, Host based authentication, keyboard authentication and authentication of servers.

links.context: This set of Computer Networks Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “DHCP”.

mcqs.question: DHCP (dynamic host configuration protocol) provides __________ to the client.
mcqs.explanation: We use DHCP to allow the hosts to acquire their ip addresses dynamically which is better than visiting each and every host on the network and configure all of this information manually.

mcqs.question: DHCP is used for ________
mcqs.explanation: DHCP is used for both IPv4 and IPv6 addressing. With DHCP you get to let the hosts know about the change dynamically, and hosts update their info themselves.

mcqs.question: The DHCP server _________

options.a: a) maintains a database of available IP addresses
options.b: b) maintains the information about client configuration parameters
options.c: c) grants a IP address when receives a request from a client

mcqs.explanation: Whenever a DHCP server gets a request from a client it responds with a DHCP offer containing IP address being offered, network mask offered, the amount of time that the client can use and keep it, the ip address of the DHCP server making this offer.

mcqs.question: IP assigned for a client by DHCP server is
mcqs.explanation: The IP address offered to a client is only for a limited period of time. There is actually a certain amount of time that the client can use and keep this IP address.

mcqs.question: DHCP uses UDP port _________ for sending data to the server.
mcqs.explanation: 67 is the UDP port number that is used as the destination port of a server. Whereas UDP port number 68 is used by the client.

mcqs.question: The DHCP server can provide the _______ of the IP addresses.
mcqs.explanation: When a host acquires multiple offers of IP addresses from different DHCP servers, the host will broadcast a dhcp request identifying the server whose offer has been accepted.

mcqs.question: DHCP client and servers on the same subnet communicate via _________
mcqs.explanation: DHCP actually employs a connectionless service, which is provided by UDP, since TCP is connection oriented. It is implemented with two UDP port numbers 67 and 68 for its operations.

mcqs.question: After obtaining the IP address, to prevent the IP conflict the client may use _________
mcqs.explanation: ARP abbreviation for address resolution protocol is used for mapping IP addresses to MAC addresses that are present in the local network.

mcqs.question: What is DHCP snooping?

options.a: a) techniques applied to ensure the security of an existing DHCP infrastructure
options.b: b) encryption of the DHCP server requests

mcqs.answer: a) techniques applied to ensure the security of an existing DHCP infrastructure
mcqs.explanation: DHCP snooping is a security feature that is used in OS of a network in the layer 2. This technology prevents unauthorized DHCP servers offering IP addresses to DHCP clients.

mcqs.question: If DHCP snooping is configured on a LAN switch, then clients having specific ______ can access the network.

options.c: c) Both MAC address and IP address

mcqs.answer: c) Both MAC address and IP address
mcqs.explanation: The DHCP snooping is done to prevent unauthorized IP addresses being offered by unauthorized servers. This features allows only specific mac addresses and IP addresses to access the network.

links.context: This set of Computer Networks Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “IPSecurity”.

mcqs.question: IPSec is designed to provide security at the _________
mcqs.explanation: IPSec is a set of protocols used to provide authentication, data integrity and confidentiality between two machines in an IP network. In the TCP/IP model, it provides security at the IP layer i.e. the network layer.

mcqs.question: In tunnel mode, IPSec protects the ______
mcqs.explanation: In the tunnel mode, IPSec adds control bits into the packets to encrypt the entire packet between the IPSec endpoints. Using encryption, it provides secure communication between the two endpoints.

mcqs.question: Which component is included in IP security?
mcqs.explanation: AH ensures that there is no retransmission of data from an unauthorized source, and protects against data tampering. ESP provides with content protection and ensures that there is integrity and confidentiality for the message. IKE is used to make sure that only the intended sender and receiver can access the message.

mcqs.question: WPA2 is used for security in _______
mcqs.explanation: WPA2 or WiFi Protected Access 2 is a security protocol used to provide users and firms with strong data security and protection for their wireless networks (WiFi) to give them confidence that only authorized users can access their network.

mcqs.question: An attempt to make a computer resource unavailable to its intended users is called ______
mcqs.explanation: In a Denial of Service attack, the attacker won’t let the victims access the network by using a certain method that ensures that an essential network resource is unavailable to the victim. The methods that the attacker can use are vulnerability attack, bandwidth flooding and connection flooding.

mcqs.question: Extensible authentication protocol is authentication framework frequently used in ______
mcqs.explanation: The Extensible Authentication Protocol (EAP) is an authentication protocol used to connect a network node to the Internet. It designed through extending the methods used by the Point-to-Point Protocol for authentication.

mcqs.question: Pretty good privacy (PGP) is used in ______
mcqs.explanation: PGP is an encryption method used in e-mail security to encrypt and decrypt the content of an e-mail transmitted over the internet. It makes sure that the message cannot be stolen by other unauthorized users.

mcqs.question: PGP encrypts data by using a block cipher called ______
mcqs.explanation: The IDEA was designed in 1991 by Xuejia Lai and James Massey. Before IDEA, PGP used the cipher method BassOmatic.

mcqs.question: When a DNS server accepts and uses incorrect information from a host that has no authority giving that information, then it is called _________
mcqs.explanation: In DNS spoofing, also known as DNS cache poisoning, an attacker gets the valid credentials from a victim by spoofing the intended resource, and tricking the victim to give his/her valid authorization credentials.

links.context:
This set of Computer Networks Questions and Answers focuses on “Virtual Private Networks”.

Technical Primer for this Topic: What is VPN?

mcqs.question: A ___________ is an extension of an enterprise’s private intranet across a public network such as the internet, creating a secure private connection.
mcqs.explanation: VPN provides enhanced security and online anonymity to users on the internet. It is also used to unblock websites that are unavailable in certain regions.

mcqs.question: When were VPNs introduced into the commercial world?
mcqs.explanation: VPNs were first introduced in the year 1996. Then as the internet started to get popularized, the need for connection security increased. VPN was a great solution to this, and that’s when VPNs were implemented in the commercial world.

mcqs.question: What protocol is NOT used in the operation of a VPN?
mcqs.explanation: PPTP is a tunneling protocol which was initially used for the creation of VPNs. IPSec is used in encrypting the traffic flowing in the VPN. L2TP is used to tunnel all the L2 traffic on the VPN.

mcqs.question: Which of the following statements is NOT true concerning VPNs?

options.a: a) Financially rewarding compared to leased lines
options.b: b) Allows remote workers to access corporate data
options.c: c) Allows LAN-to-LAN connectivity over public networks
options.d: d) Is the backbone of the Internet

mcqs.answer: d) Is the backbone of the Internet
mcqs.explanation: VPNs are not the backbone of the Internet as they are just a method to create private intranets on the internet. They are used for enhancing the connection security for the users.

mcqs.question: Traffic in a VPN is NOT ____________

options.b: b) Logically separated from other traffic
options.c: c) Accessible from unauthorized public networks
options.d: d) Restricted to a single protocol in IPsec

mcqs.answer: c) Accessible from unauthorized public networks
mcqs.explanation: Traffic in a VPN is not accessible from any unauthorized public networks because it is secured with the masking IP address. This provides the benefit of access to blocked resources to the users.

mcqs.question: VPNs are financially speaking __________

options.a: a) Always more expensive than leased lines
options.b: b) Always cheaper than leased lines
options.c: c) Usually cheaper than leased lines
options.d: d) Usually more expensive than leased lines

mcqs.answer: c) Usually cheaper than leased lines
mcqs.explanation: The services of a VPN are cheaper for moderate to large scale institutional networks than the services of leased lines. Though for a small scale network, it does not prove to be as beneficial as the costs are not reduced to a great degree as compared to leased lines.

mcqs.question: Which layer 3 protocols can be transmitted over an L2TP VPN?
mcqs.explanation: L2TP stands for Layer 2 Tunneling Protocol. It is used to tunnel all the L2 traffic on an IP network and is able to transmit network layer’s IP and IPX protocol data.

mcqs.question: ESP (Encapsulating Security Protocol) is defined in which of the following standards?
mcqs.explanation: ESP is a security component of IPSec. ESP provides content protection and ensures that there is integrity and confidentiality of the message. The other security components of IPSec are Authentication Header and Internet Key Exchange.

mcqs.question: L2F was developed by which company?
mcqs.explanation: L2F stands for Layer 2 Forwarding protocol. It was designed by Cisco to tunnel PPP traffic, helping create VPNs over the internet.

mcqs.question: Which layer of the OSI reference model does PPTP work at?
mcqs.explanation: PPTP stands for Point-to-Point Tunneling Protocol. PPTP is a tunneling protocol that was primitively used to create VPNs. It is no longer used for VPNs due to the lack of security it provides.

mcqs.question: Which layer of the OSI reference model does IPsec work at?
mcqs.explanation: IPSec is a set of protocols used to provide authentication, data integrity and confidentiality between two machines in an IP network. It operates in the network layer.

links.context: This set of Computer Networks Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “SMI”.

mcqs.question: Storage management comprises of _______________
mcqs.explanation: SAN management, data protection and disk operation are the main components of the Storage Management Initiative Specification. SMI-S was developed by the Storage Networking Industry Association.

mcqs.question: Which of the following is not a storage device?
mcqs.explanation: Switches, RAID arrays and tape drives are the main storage devices in SMI-S, while a Hub is simple networking device that cannot be used as storage.

mcqs.question: Which protocols are used for Storage management?
mcqs.explanation: Simple Network Management Protocol is used for storage management. Lightweight Directory Access Protocol is used to access or locate information about directories and other resources on a network. Post Office Protocol 3 is used for e-mailing on the internet. Management Information Base is a part of SNMP and contains hierarchically organized information.

mcqs.question: Identify the difficulty a SAN administrator does not incur while dealing with diverse vendors.

options.b: b) Multiple applications to manage storage in the data center

mcqs.explanation: A single view is not possible with diverse vendors present. Proprietary management interfaces, multiple applications management and no single view are the main difficulties incurred by a SAN administrator in such a situation.

mcqs.question: How do Storage administrators ensure secure access to storage devices?

options.b: b) By putting a physical lock on the storage device
options.c: c) By keeping devices shutdown when not in use
options.d: d) By keeping devices when used

mcqs.explanation: Zoning is a method in SAN that can be used by a storage administrator to specify who can see what in the SAN. Zoning might complicate the scaling process if the size of the SAN increases.

mcqs.question: Effective Storage management does not include __________
mcqs.explanation: Connection is the responsibility of the connection manager. Storage management includes management of all necessities such as security, backups and reporting facilities.

mcqs.question: Among the following, identify which task is not involved in Storage Capacity management?

options.a: a) Identifying storage systems are approaching full capacity
options.b: b) Monitoring trends for each resource
options.c: c) Tracking Total capacity, total used, total available
options.d: d) Preventing unauthorized access to the storage

mcqs.answer: d) Preventing unauthorized access to the storage
mcqs.explanation: Prevention of unauthorized access to storage is the task of Security management. Identifying when the storage is approaching full capacity, monitoring trends, reporting and tracking capacity are the tasks of Storage Capacity management.

mcqs.question: Effect of open standards like SMI(s) is _______________

options.a: a) standardization drives software interoperability and interchange ability
options.b: b) breaks the old-style dependence on proprietary methods, trade secrets, and single   providers
options.c: c) builds a strong foundation on which others can quickly build and innovate

mcqs.explanation: Open standards like SMI-S inculcate a general ideal through which the normal designers are able to easily implement the standard into their software and its scalability. Since it is open-source, nothing is hidden from its users and they can implement it as they like or require to. As a whole lot of time is spent to build it as strong and scalable, it provides an efficient foundation to the designers to build and innovate on.

mcqs.question: Task of Distributed Management Task Force is not ________

options.a: a) to promote interoperability among the management solution providers
options.b: b) to act as an interface between the various budding technologies and provide solution to manage various environments
options.c: c) to track the operation of the different management solution providers
options.d: d) to manage the facility by itself if one of the management solution providers fail

mcqs.answer: d) to manage the facility by itself if one of the management solution providers fail
mcqs.explanation: The Distributed Management Task Force is used just to simplify the overall management of the network. It cannot manage a network facility by itself in case one of the management solution providers fails. It provides an interface for promoting interoperability among management solution providers.

mcqs.question: SMI-S Standard uses which of the following?
mcqs.explanation: The Distributed Management Task Force maintains a Common Information Model (CIM) to represent a common set of network objects and their relationships. CIM-XML/HTTP refers to the operations of CIM being performed over HTTP or XML. SMI-S uses CIM-XML/HTTP.

links.context: This set of Computer Networks Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Telnet – 1”.

mcqs.question: The application layer protocol used by a Telnet application is ________
mcqs.explanation: Telnet is an application layer protocol that provides access to the command-line interface on a remote host. Telnet stands for teletype network.

mcqs.question: Which amongst the following statements is correct for “character at a time” mode?

options.a: a) Character processing is done on the local system under the control of the remote system
options.b: b) Most text typed is immediately sent to the remote host for processing
options.c: c) All text is echoed locally, only completed lines are sent to the remote host
options.d: d) All text is processed locally, and only confirmed lines are sent to the remote host

mcqs.answer: b) Most text typed is immediately sent to the remote host for processing
mcqs.explanation: In character at a time mode, the typed text is sent immediately to the remote host while the user is typing. Another mode used in Telnet is “Old line by line” mode in which only completed lines are sent to the remote host.

mcqs.question: _______ allows you to connect and login to a remote computer
mcqs.explanation: Telnet provides access to the command-line interface on a remote computer. One can login to the computer from the command-line interface.

mcqs.question: What is the correct syntax to be written in the web browser to initiate a Telnet connection to www.sanfoundry.com?
mcqs.explanation: telnet://” is the header to be used to initiate a Telnet connection to a web server. One can browse the website using telnet if they are authorized to.

mcqs.question: Telnet is used for _______
mcqs.explanation: Telnet is an application layer protocol that provides access to the command line interface of a remote computer that can be used to perform remote login.

mcqs.question: Which one of the following is not correct?

options.a: a) telnet is a general purpose client-server program
options.b: b) telnet lets user access an application on a remote computer
options.c: c) telnet can also be used for file transfer
options.d: d) telnet can be used for remote login

mcqs.answer: c) telnet can also be used for file transfer
mcqs.explanation: File Transfer Protocol is used for file transfer. Telnet provides access to the command-line interface on a remote host.

mcqs.question: Which operating mode of telnet is full duplex?
mcqs.explanation: In line mode, terminal character processing is done on the client side but editing is enabled on the server side. Line mode reduces the number of packets and is useful for long delay networks.

mcqs.question: If we want that a character be interpreted by the client instead of server _________

options.a: a) interpret as command (IAC) escape character has to be used
options.b: b) control functions has to be disabled
options.d: d) cli character has to be used

mcqs.answer: a) interpret as command (IAC) escape character has to be used
mcqs.explanation: The client must look at each byte that arrives and look for IAC escape character. If IAC is found, the client moves on to look for any other code or IAC. If the next byte is IAC – a single byte is presented by the client to the terminal. If IAC is followed by any other code than IAC, the client interprets this as a command.

links.context: This set of Computer Networks Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Telnet – 2”.

mcqs.question: Telnet protocol is used to establish a connection to __________
mcqs.explanation: TCP port 21 is used for FTP, TCP port 22 is used for SSH and TCP port 25 is used for SMTP. Telnet provides access to a command line interface on a remote computer using the TCP port number 23.

mcqs.question: Which one of the following is not true?

options.a: a) telnet defines a network virtual terminal (NVT) standard
options.b: b) client programs interact with NVT
options.d: d) client can transfer files using to remote server using NVT

mcqs.answer: d) client can transfer files using to remote server using NVT
mcqs.explanation: The client can use the NVT only to interact with the programs already present on the remote server, not to transfer files to it. To transfer files, an FTP connection has to be used.

mcqs.question: All telnet operations are sent as ________
mcqs.explanation: Telnet provides a bi-directional, 8-bit byte oriented communications facility through which operations are sent as 8-bit bytes for the server to interpret.

mcqs.question: AbsoluteTelnet is a telnet client for _______ Operating system.
mcqs.explanation: AbsoluteTelnet was originally released in 1999. It was developed by Brian Pence of Celestial Software.

mcqs.question: The decimal code of Interpret as Command (IAC) character is _______
mcqs.explanation: If we want that a character be interpreted by the client instead of server, we use the IAC character. If IAC is followed by any other code than IAC, the client interprets it as a character.

mcqs.question: Which of the following is true for character mode operation of telnet implementation?

options.a: a) each character typed is sent by the client to the server
options.b: b) each character typed is discarded by the server
options.c: c) each character typed is aggregated into a word and then sent to the server
options.d: d) each character type is aggregated into a line and then sent to the server

mcqs.answer: a) each character typed is sent by the client to the server
mcqs.explanation: In character mode, each character that the user is typing is immediately sent to the server which then interprets it only after the complete operation command is received.

mcqs.question: In which mode of telnet, the client echoes the character on the screen but does not send it until a whole line is completed?
mcqs.explanation: In the default mode, the client does not send each character typed by the user to the server, thus saving the amount of packet transmissions required for executing each operation. But the server has to remain idle until the client sends the completed line wasting a lot of time.

mcqs.question: Which one of the following is not correct?

options.a: a) telnet is a general purpose client-server program
options.b: b) telnet lets user access an application on a remote computer
options.c: c) telnet can also be used for file transfer
options.d: d) telnet can be used for remote login

mcqs.answer: c) telnet can also be used for file transfer
mcqs.explanation: File Transfer Protocol is used for file transfer. Telnet provides access to the command-line interface on a remote host.

title: 5. Computer Network MCQ on Transport Layer

links.context:
This set of Computer Networks Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “TCP-1”.

Prep Material for this Topic: What is Transmission Control Protocol (TCP)?

mcqs.question: Which of the following is false with respect to TCP?
mcqs.explanation: TCP is a transport layer protocol that provides reliable and ordered delivery of a stream of bytes between hosts communicating via an IP network.

mcqs.question: In TCP, sending and receiving data is done as _______
mcqs.explanation: TCP provides stream oriented delivery between hosts communicating via an IP network and there are no message boundaries. TCP can concatenate data from a number of send () commands into one stream of data and still transmit it reliably.

mcqs.question: TCP process may not write and read data at the same speed. So we need __________ for storage.
mcqs.explanation: A TCP receiver has a receive buffer that is used to store the unprocessed incoming packets in case the sender is sending packets faster than the processing rate of the received packets.

mcqs.question: TCP groups a number of bytes together into a packet called _______
mcqs.explanation: A segment may be collection of data from many send () statements. TCP transmits each segment as a stream of bytes.

mcqs.question: Communication offered by TCP is ________
mcqs.explanation: Data can flow both the directions at the same time during a TCP communication hence, it is full-duplex. This is the reason why TCP is used in systems that require full-duplex operation such as e-mail systems.

mcqs.question: To achieve reliable transport in TCP, ___________ is used to check the safe and sound arrival of data.
mcqs.explanation: Acknowledgment mechanism is used to check the safe and sound arrival of data. The sender actively checks for acknowledgement from the receiver and once a specific time period has passed, it retransmits the data.

mcqs.question: In segment header, sequence number and acknowledgement number fields refer to _______
mcqs.explanation: As TCP has to ensure ordered delivery of packets, sequence number and acknowledgement number are used to identify the byte number of the packet in the stream of bytes being transmitted.

mcqs.question: Suppose a TCP connection is transferring a file of 1000 bytes. The first byte is numbered 10001. What is the sequence number of the segment if all data is sent in only one segment?
mcqs.explanation: The sequence number given to first byte of a segment, with respect to its order among the previous segments, is the sequence number of that segment.

mcqs.question: Bytes of data being transferred in each connection are numbered by TCP. These numbers start with a _________

options.d: d) Sequence of zero’s and one’s

mcqs.answer: d) Sequence of zero’s and one’s
mcqs.explanation: One might expect the sequence number of the first byte in the stream to be 0, or 1. But that does not happen in TCP, Instead, the sender has to choose an Initial Sequence Number (ISN), which is basically a random 32 bit sequence of 0’s and 1’s, during the connection handshake.

mcqs.question: The value of acknowledgement field in a segment defines _______

options.a: a) sequence number of the byte received previously
options.b: b) total number of bytes to receive
options.c: c) sequence number of the next byte to be received
options.d: d) sequence of zeros and ones

mcqs.answer: c) sequence number of the next byte to be received
mcqs.explanation: The acknowledgement field in a segment defines the sequence number of the byte which is to be received next i.e. sequence number of byte that the sender should transmit next.

links.context:
This set of Computer Networks Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “TCP – 2”.

Technical Primer for this Topic: TCP Flow Control

mcqs.question: The receiver of the data controls the amount of data that are to be sent by the sender is referred to as ___________
mcqs.explanation: Flow control is done to prevent the receiver from being overflowed with data. It is done using various open-loop (prevention) methods and closed-loop (recovery) methods.

mcqs.question: Size of TCP segment header ranges between ___________
mcqs.explanation: The size of the header can be 20 bytes at a minimum if there are no options and can go up to 60 bytes at maximum with 40 bytes in the options field. The header contains all the control information required to ensure ordered, error-free and reliable delivery of the segment.

mcqs.question: Connection establishment in TCP is done by which mechanism?
mcqs.explanation: A three-way handshake allows both, the server and the client to choose their Initial Sequence Number and inform about it to the other party. This won’t be possible using the two-way handshake mechanism.

mcqs.question: The server program tells its TCP that it is ready to accept a connection. This process is called ___________
mcqs.explanation: This is the first step in the Three-Way Handshaking process and is started by the server. Then the Client picks an ISN (Initial Sequence Number) and synchronizes (shares) it with the Server requesting a connection. The Server acknowledges the clients ISN, and then picks an ISN and synchronizes it with the Client. At last, the Client acknowledges the servers ISN.

mcqs.question: A client that wishes to connect to an open server tells its TCP that it needs to be connected to that particular server. The process is called ___________
mcqs.explanation: This is the second step in the Three-Way Handshaking process and is done by the client once it finds the open server and picks an ISN. The Server acknowledges the clients request, and then picks an ISN and synchronizes it with the Client. At last, the Client acknowledges the servers ISN.

mcqs.question: In Three-Way Handshaking process, the situation where both the TCP’s issue an active open is ___________
mcqs.explanation: In simultaneous open situation, two nodes send an SYN signal to each other and start a TCP connection. Here, both TCP nodes transmit a SYNC+ACK segment to each other and a connection is established between them. This doesn’t happen usually, because both sides have to know which port on the other side to send to.

mcqs.question: A malicious attacker sends a large number of SYNC segments to a server, pretending that each of them is coming from a different client by faking the source IP address in the datagram. Which type of attack is being performed in this situation?
mcqs.explanation: SYNC flooding attack is a form of Denial of Service attack. Due to the overflow of SYNC segments sent to the server, the victims are not able to request for a connection to the server, thus resulting in Denial of Service.

mcqs.question: SYNC flooding attack belongs to a type of security attack known as ___________
mcqs.explanation: During SYNC flooding the system collapses and denies service to every request, making it a DoS attack. Some other DoS attacks are bandwidth flooding, connection flooding and UDP flooding.

mcqs.question: The sizes of source and destination port address in TCP header are ___________ respectively.
mcqs.explanation: All port addresses are of 16 bits and they specify the type of service being used by the network entity. For example, port 21 is used for FTP connections and port 25 is used for ICMP connections.

mcqs.question: What allows TCP to detect lost segments and in turn recover from that loss?
mcqs.explanation: TCP header contains separate fields for sequence number and acknowledgment number. Comparing these values is what allows TCP to detect lost segments and in turn recover from that loss. After detecting the lost segments, the recovery may require retransmission of the lost segments of data.

links.context:
This set of Computer Networks Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “UDP”.

Foundational Reading for this Topic: User Datagram Protocol (UDP)

mcqs.question: Which of the following is false with respect to UDP?
mcqs.explanation: UDP is an unreliable, connectionless transport layer protocol that provides message-based data transmission. TCP is an example of connection-oriented protocols.

mcqs.question: Return value of the UDP port “Chargen” is _______

options.c: c) Array of characters with integers
options.d: d) Array of zero’s and one’s

mcqs.explanation: Using Chargen with UDP on port 19, the server sends a UDP datagram containing a random number of characters every time it receives a datagram from the connecting host. The number of characters is between 0 and 512.

mcqs.question: Beyond IP, UDP provides additional services such as _______

options.b: b) Sending and receiving of packets

mcqs.explanation: De-multiplexing is the delivering of received segments to the correct application layer processes at the recipients end using UDP. Error checking is done through checksum in UDP.

mcqs.question: What is the main advantage of UDP?
mcqs.explanation: As UDP does not provide assurance of delivery of packet, reliability and other services, the overhead taken to provide these services is reduced in UDP’s operation. Thus, UDP provides low overhead, and higher speed.

mcqs.question: Port number used by Network Time Protocol (NTP) with UDP is ________
mcqs.explanation: The Network Time Protocol is a clock synchronization network protocol implemented by using UDP port number 123 to send and receive time stamps.

mcqs.question: What is the header size of a UDP packet?
mcqs.explanation: The fixed size of the UDP packet header is 8 bytes. It contains four two-byte fields: Source port address, Destination port address, Length of packet, and checksum.

mcqs.question: The port number is “ephemeral port number”, if the source host is _______
mcqs.explanation: Port numbers from 1025 to 5000 are used as ephemeral port numbers in Windows Operating System. Ephemeral port numbers are short-lived port numbers which can be used for clients in a UDP system where there are temporary clients all the time.

mcqs.question: “Total length” field in UDP packet header is the length of _________
mcqs.explanation: Total length is the 16 bit field which contains the length of UDP header and the data. The maximum value of the Total length field and the maximum size of a UDP datagram is 65,535 bytes (8 byte header + 65,527 bytes of data).

mcqs.question: Which is the correct expression for the length of UDP datagram?

options.a: a) UDP length = IP length – IP header’s length
options.b: b) UDP length = UDP length – UDP header’s length
options.c: c) UDP length = IP length + IP header’s length
options.d: d) UDP length = UDP length + UDP header’s length

mcqs.answer: a) UDP length = IP length – IP header’s length
mcqs.explanation: A user datagram is encapsulated in an IP datagram. There is a field in the IP header that defines the total length of the IP packet. There is another field in the IP header that defines the length of the header. So if we subtract the length of the IP header that is encapsulated in the IP packet, we get the length of UDP datagram.

mcqs.question: The ______ field is used to detect errors over the entire user datagram.
mcqs.explanation: Checksum field is used to detect errors over the entire user datagram. Though it is not as efficient as CRC which is used in TCP, it gets the job done for the UDP datagram as UDP doesn’t have to ensure the delivery of the packet.

links.context: This set of Computer Networks Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Reliable Data Transfer”.

mcqs.question: Which layer is more helpful in providing reliable data transmission service?
mcqs.explanation: Transport layer uses some protocols, such as UDP, TCP and SCTP to accomplish reliability. UDP works well for real time data and has multiple ways for packet transmission. SCTP and TCP also provide reliable services by establishing connections and make use of their special features like error control and flow control.

mcqs.question: Which protocol works well over an inter network in case of reliability?
mcqs.explanation: TCP can work well because it is robust and helps the packets to be delivered safely and quickly and it does not cause congestion. TCP was defined in RFC 793 and it has improved in a way that it can adapt the attributes of internet and deals with errors well.

mcqs.question: Which transport layer protocols are reliable?
mcqs.explanation: TCP and SCTP are connection oriented protocols and they ensure that there is no packet loss. Also, these protocols use different methods and mechanisms such as flow control, error control, congestion control and acknowledgments to achieve reliability.

mcqs.question: Which of the following mechanism is used by the TCP to guard the receiver from data overwhelming?
mcqs.explanation: Senders may send the data at a rate that can not be handled by a receiver and may drench the receiver with load. In such scenarios, flow control mechanism informs the receiver to decrease the rate at which it is sending. If the rate is very slow, then the sender will be asked to increase the rate.

mcqs.question: Which of the following protocol(s) supports uni-casting?
mcqs.explanation: TCP supports uni-casting transmission, where only one receiver and one sender will be present and it requires source and destination IP addresses only. Multi-casting is another version of transmission in which more than one receiver can be present.

mcqs.question: Which of the following protocol is multi stream oriented?
mcqs.explanation: Stream control transmission protocol provides the facility to transmit multiple streams for a single connection. That is, a single connection can have multiple ways and block of one way(path) does not affect other streams.

mcqs.question: What is the sequence of phases in TCP connection?

options.a: a) Connection establishment – connection termination – data transfer
options.b: b) Connection establishment – data transfer – connection termination
options.c: c) Data transfer – connection establishment – connection termination
options.d: d) Data transfer – connection termination – connection establishment

mcqs.answer: b) Connection establishment – data transfer – connection termination
mcqs.explanation: Primarily, the sender sends the request to a receiver in order to establish a connection; if the receiver accepts the request, then the data transfer takes place. After the transmission, connection is terminated.

mcqs.question: Which of the following is not related to transmission control protocol?
mcqs.explanation: Multi-casting has more than one receiver host for a stream of data that is sent by a process and it maintains a group. But TCP supports uni-casting, in which one sender will have only one receiver. Broadcasting is also not supported by TCP.

mcqs.question: Which of the following is not a similarity between transmission control protocol and user datagram protocol?
mcqs.explanation: The major difference between TCP and UDP is connection, UDP is connection less protocol whereas TCP is connection oriented. UDP facilitates the application’s process to send the datagrams without building a connection between the two processes.

mcqs.question: Reliability at the transport layer is between hosts.
mcqs.explanation: Transport layer deals with processes that are running on different hosts, hence reliability is achieved between processes. A single host can have multiple processes running in it with different port numbers. Reliability between hosts can be achieved by data link layer.

links.context: This set of Computer Networks Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “AH and ESP Protocols”.

mcqs.question: Which mode of IPsec should you use to assure the security and confidentiality of data within the same LAN?
mcqs.explanation: ESP transport mode should be used to ensure the integrity and confidentiality of data that is exchanged within the same LAN. ESP tunnel mode is comparatively more secure and should be used to assure the security of the data within different LANs.

mcqs.question: Which two types of encryption protocols can be used to secure the authentication of computers using IPsec?
mcqs.explanation: SHA or MD5 can be used. Kerberos V5 is an authentication protocol, not an encryption protocol; therefore, answer A is incorrect. Certificates are a type of authentication that can be used with IPsec, not an encryption protocol; therefore, answer B is incorrect.

mcqs.question: Which two types of IPsec can be used to secure communications between two LANs?

options.c: c) Both AH tunnel mode and ESP tunnel mode

mcqs.answer: c) Both AH tunnel mode and ESP tunnel mode
mcqs.explanation: The AH and ESP tunnel mode IPSec should be used for data transfer purpose, option d is for integrity & confidentiality purpose. Tunnel mode provides security for the entire original IP packet unlike transport mode which is not as secure as it only encrypts the data portion and not the whole packet.

mcqs.question: ______ provides authentication at the IP level.
mcqs.explanation: The Authentication Header (AH) authenticates the origin of data, and guarantees the integrity of the information that’s being sent using IPSec. It also provides anti-reply security.

mcqs.question: IPsec defines two protocols: _______ and ________
mcqs.explanation: AH ensures that there is no retransmission of data from an unauthorized source, and protects against data tampering. ESP provides with content protection and ensures that there is integrity and confidentiality for the message.

mcqs.question: IP Security operates in which layer of the OSI model?
mcqs.explanation: IPSec is a set of protocols used to provide authentication, data integrity and confidentiality between two machines in an IP network. In the TCP/IP model, it provides security at the IP layer i.e. the network layer.

mcqs.question: ESP does not provide ________
mcqs.explanation: The ESP provides data confidentiality, integrity and authentication. It provides confidentiality through encryption.  ESP can operate in two modes, transport mode and tunnel mode.

mcqs.question: In computer security _______ means that computer system assets can be modified only by authorized parities.
mcqs.explanation: Integrity means that computer system assets can be modified only by authorized parities. Confidentiality means that the assets can only be accessed by authorized parties. Availability refers to the accessibility of the resource to the authorized parties. Authenticity means that the asset is not unethically changed.

mcqs.question: In computer security _______ means that the information in a computer system only be accessible for reading by authorized parities.
mcqs.explanation: Confidentiality means that the assets can only be accessed by authorized parties. Integrity means that computer system assets can be modified only by authorized parities. Availability refers to the accessibility of the resource to the authorized parties. Authenticity means that the asset is not unethically changed.

mcqs.question: Which of the following organizations is primarily concerned with military encryption systems?
mcqs.explanation: The NSA is primarily responsible for military encryption systems. The NSA designs evaluates, and implements encryption systems for the military and government agencies with high security needs.

title: 6. Computer Network MCQ on Frame Relay

links.context:
This set of Computer Networks Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Congestion Control”.

Essential Pre-read for this Topic: Congestion Control in Computer Network

mcqs.question: Two broad categories of congestion control are

options.c: c) Active  control and Passive control
options.d: d) Active loop and Passive loop

mcqs.explanation: Open loop congestion control techniques are used to prevent congestion before it even happens by enforcing certain policies. Closed loop congestion control techniques are used to treat congestion after it has happened.

mcqs.question: In open-loop control, policies are applied to __________
mcqs.explanation: Open loop congestion control techniques are used to prevent congestion before it even happens by enforcing certain policies. Retransmission policy, window policy and acknowledgement policy are some policies that might be enforced.

mcqs.question: Retransmission of packets must not be done when _______
mcqs.explanation: Retransmission refers to the sender having to resend the packet to the receiver. It needs to be done only when some anomaly occurs with the packet like when the packet is lost or corrupted.

mcqs.question: In Go-Back-N window, when the timer of the packet times out, several packets have to be resent even some may have arrived safe. Whereas in Selective Repeat window, the sender resends ___________

options.a: a) Packet which are not lost
options.b: b) Only those packets which are lost or corrupted

mcqs.answer: b) Only those packets which are lost or corrupted
mcqs.explanation: In Selective Repeat, the sender side uses a searching algorithm to find the packets which need to be retransmitted based on the negative acknowledgements received and then resends only those packets thus saving bandwidth.

mcqs.question: Discarding policy is mainly done by _______
mcqs.explanation: The discarding policy adopted by the routers mainly states that the routers discard sensitive or corrupted packets that it receives, thus controlling the integrity of the packet flow. The discarding policy is adopted as an open loop congestion control technique.

mcqs.question: Closed-Loop control mechanisms try to _________
mcqs.explanation: In closed loop congestion control, methods are implemented to remove congestion after it occurs. Some of the methods used are backpressure and choke packet.

mcqs.question: The technique in which a congested node stops receiving data from the immediate upstream node or nodes is called as _______
mcqs.explanation: In this closed loop congestion control technique, the congested node propagates in the opposite direction of the data flow to inform the predecessor node to reduce the flow of packets. This is why this technique is called a node-to-node congestion control technique.

mcqs.question: Backpressure technique can be applied only to _______
mcqs.explanation: In Virtual circuit networks, each node knows the upstream node from which a flow data is coming. So, it makes possible for the congested node to track the source of the congestion and then inform that node to reduce the flow to remove congestion.

mcqs.question: The packet sent by a node to the source to inform it of congestion is called _______
mcqs.explanation: Choke packet is sent by a node to the source to inform it of congestion. Two choke packet techniques can be used for the operation called hop-by-hop choke packet and source choke packet.

mcqs.question: In the slow-start algorithm, the size of the congestion window increases __________ until it reaches a threshold.
mcqs.explanation: In slow-start algorithm, the size of the congestion window increases exponentially until it reaches a threshold. When it reaches the threshold, it stops increasing and continues sending packets through the threshold window thus preventing congestion.

mcqs.question: In the congestion avoidance algorithm, the size of the congestion window increases ____________ until congestion is detected.
mcqs.explanation: In the congestion avoidance algorithm, the size of the congestion window increases additively until congestion is detected. Once congestion is detected, the size of congestion window is decreased once and then the packets are transmitted to achieve congestion avoidance.

links.context: This set of Computer Networks Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Virtual Circuit”.

mcqs.question: Which of the following is not a characteristic of Virtual Circuit Network?

options.a: a) There are setup and teardown phases in addition to the data transfer phase
options.b: b) Resources can be allocated during setup phase or on demand
options.c: c) All packets follow the same path established during the connection
options.d: d) Virtual circuit network is implemented in application layer

mcqs.answer: d) Virtual circuit network is implemented in application layer
mcqs.explanation: Virtual circuit network is normally implemented in data link layer. It is a combination of circuit-switched network and datagram network which are implemented in the physical layer and network layer respectively.

mcqs.question: The address that is unique in the scope of the network or internationally if the network is part of an international network is called as ______
mcqs.explanation: Global address is a network address that is unique internationally and is used as a common address by all the users of the network. It is used to create a virtual circuit identifier.

mcqs.question: The Identifier that is used for data transfer in virtual circuit network is called _______
mcqs.explanation: A virtual circuit identifier is a type of numeric identifying address that is used to distinguish between different virtual circuits in a circuit-switched network. It is used for data transfer and has a switch scope.

mcqs.question: Which of the following is not a phase of virtual circuit network?
mcqs.explanation: There are three phases in a virtual circuit network: setup, data transfer and teardown phase. There is no termination phase in it.

mcqs.question: Steps required in setup process are ___________

options.b: b) Setup request and setup response
options.c: c) Setup request and setup termination

mcqs.explanation: Setup request (sent by a source) and acknowledgement (sent by the destination) are the steps in the setup process. Both the ends’ switches make table entries during the setup process.

mcqs.question: During teardown phase, the source, after sending all the frames to destination, sends a _____ to notify termination.
mcqs.explanation: The source, after sending all the frames to destination sends teardown request to which, destination sends teardown response. The switches then delete the corresponding table entries.

mcqs.question: Delay of the resource allocated during setup phase during data transfer is ________
mcqs.explanation: If a resource is allocated during setup phase, delay is same for each packet as there is only one-time delay during the setup phase and no delay during the data transfer phase.

mcqs.question: Delay of the resource allocated on demand during data transfer is ________
mcqs.explanation: If a resource is to be allocated on demand during the data transfer phase, the delay for each packet would be different depending upon the resource requirement of the packets.

mcqs.question: In virtual circuit network, the number of delay times for setup and teardown respectively are _______
mcqs.explanation: There is one-time delay for both setup and teardown phase. The one-time delay in setup phase is for resource allocation and the one-time delay in teardown phase is for the de-allocation of the resources.

mcqs.question: In data transfer phase, how many columns does the table contain?
mcqs.explanation: The switch maintains a table for each Virtual Circuit Network. In the data transfer phase, it maintains 2 columns each for incoming data and outgoing data. The columns are in the following order: Source port, Source VCI, Destination port, Destination VCI.

links.context: This set of Computer Networks Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “ATM & Frame Relay”.

mcqs.question: ATM uses _______________
mcqs.explanation: ATM uses a constant data stream consisting of transmission cells to transmit information in a fixed division of time. The packet size remains fixed.

mcqs.question: ATM standard defines _______ layers.
mcqs.explanation: The three layers are physical layer, ATM layer and application adoption layer. The physical layer corresponds to the physical layer, ATM layer corresponds to the data link layer and the AAL layer corresponds to the network layer of the OSI model.

mcqs.question: ATM can be used for ________
mcqs.explanation: ATM is a connection oriented network for cell relay which can be implemented for networks covering any area. It uses Time Division Multiplexing and supports voice, video and data communications.

mcqs.question: An ATM cell has the payload field of __________
mcqs.explanation: An ATM field contains a header and a payload. The header is of 5 bytes and the payload is of 48 bytes. The size of the header remains fixed.

mcqs.question: ATM and frame relay are ________
mcqs.explanation: ATM and frame relay are transmission modes in which information is transferred through electric circuit layer as packets. ATM has fixed packet size and frame relay has variable packet size.

mcqs.question: In ATM Networks, LCD stands for ____________
mcqs.explanation: The ATM has helped bring about the merger of computer and telecommunication networks. The ATM Forum, an organization that specifies standards for ATM implementation, has also provided a framework for network management. The subject of ATM is full of acronyms. Therefore LCD in ATM networks stands for ‘Loss of Cell Delineation’.

mcqs.question: How is Permanent Virtual Circuit (PVC) established?

options.a: a) It can be established by transporting packets in the sequence in which they were transmitted by the source along the same path for a given session
options.b: b) It can be established by grouping a number of virtual circuits between two switches into a virtual path
options.c: c) It can be established when the connection is established for long periods of time and not switched between sessions
options.d: d) It can be established on a per session basis or on a permanent basis between a pair of end stations that carry large volumes of traffic

mcqs.answer: c) It can be established when the connection is established for long periods of time and not switched between sessions
mcqs.explanation: The VP- VC can be established on a per session basis or on a permanent basis between a pair of end stations that carry large volumes of traffic. In the former ease, the circuit is established as and when needed and torn down after the session is over. This is called the switched virtual circuit (SVC). When the connection is established for long periods of time and not switched between sessions, a permanent virtual circuit (PVC) is established.

mcqs.question: A public network is the network that is established by the ___________
mcqs.explanation: There are two markets for ATM switches using ATM technology, public and private. A public network is the network that is established by the service provider. A private network is primarily a campus network.

mcqs.question: The broadband network can transport only very low data rate signals.
mcqs.explanation: The broadband network and the narrowband Integrated Services Digital Network (ISDN) are multimedia networks that provide integrated analog and digital services over the same network. The broadband network can transport very high data rate signals.

mcqs.question: Broadband network management consists of managing the ____________ using ATM technology.
mcqs.explanation: The broadband network can transport very high data rate signals. It is a multimedia transportation networking. The computer network uses the facilities of the telecommunication network fur transportation over WAN. Thus Broadband network management consists of managing the WAN using ATM technology.

mcqs.question: In the ATM Network reference model, the public NMS, which manages the public network, responds to the private NMS via the M2 interface.
mcqs.explanation: The ATM Forum has defined as management interface architecture, ATM network reference model. There are five interfaces between systems and networks, M1, M2, M3, M4 and M5. The public NMS, which manages the public network, responds to the private NMS via the M3 interface with the relevant information or takes the appropriate action requested.

mcqs.question: The structure of management information is defined using the _________ syntax.
mcqs.explanation: The MIB and the structure of management of information that is required for the management of the ATM network are specified between two sets of documents defined by IETF and the ATM Forum. The structure of management information is defined using the ASN.1 syntax.

mcqs.question: The _____________ in service has contributed significantly to advances in three network segments of WAN, access network and home/customer premises equipment (CPE) network.
mcqs.explanation: The broadband network has several interpretations. One of the chief characteristics of broadband service is the integration of voice, video, and data services over the same transportation medium; in other words, it is multimedia transportation networking. The broadband network and service have contributed significantly to advances in three network segments of WAN, access network. and home/customer premises equipment (CPE) network.

mcqs.question: Asynchronous Transfer Mode (ATM) is non-scalable.
mcqs.explanation: The ATM has helped bring about the merger of computer and telecommunication networks. The implementation of these concepts in a network that is made up of ATM switches achieves high-speed network that can transport all three services (voice, video, and data). The desired quality of service is provided to individual streams (unlike the current Internet) at the same time. Therefore, this network is also easily scalable.

mcqs.question: ___________ is the interface between a public NMS and a public network.
mcqs.explanation: The ATM Forum has defined as management interface architecture, ATM network reference model. There are five interfaces between systems and networks, M1, M2, M3, M4 and M5. Ml and M2 are, respectively, the interfaces between private NMS and either end-user of private network. A private NMS can access its own network-related information in a public network via an M3 interface to the public NMS. M4 is the interface between a public NMS and a public network. M5 is the interface between NMSs of two service providers.

links.context: This set of Computer Networks Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Frame Relay”.

mcqs.question: Frame Relay is cheaper than other _____
mcqs.explanation: Frame relay is a standardized wide area network technology and is popularly used because it is cheaper than leased line WANs. It is also very simple to configure user equipment in a Frame Relay network.

mcqs.question: Frame Relay networks offer an option called _______
mcqs.explanation: Frame Relay networks offer an option called Voice over Frame Relay, which transmits voice and voice-band data over a Frame Relay network. It has two sub-protocols FRF11 and FRF12.

mcqs.question: There are ________ total features of Frame Relay.
mcqs.explanation: Frame relay is a wide area network technology used to transmit information over a network in the form of frames using relays. The frames are of variable size. It is cheaper than other WANs and it’s simple to configure user equipment in the network.

mcqs.question: Frame Relay does not provide flow or error control, they must be provided by the ______
mcqs.explanation: Frame relay only provides error detection using CRC. If errors are detected, the upper-layer protocols, such as TCP are expected to provide error correction features. Network layer provides flow control.

mcqs.question: Frame Relay deploys physical layer carriers such as _______
mcqs.explanation: Frame Relays uses carriers such as SONET (for fiber-optic connections) to physically transmit data frames over a Frame Relay network. SONET is cheaper and provides better network reliability than other carriers.

mcqs.question: Frame relay provides error detection at the ______
mcqs.explanation: Frame relay provides error detection using CRC in the data link layer. The transport layer then provides the error correction features if an error is detected.

mcqs.question: Virtual circuit identifier in frame relay is called _______
mcqs.explanation: The Data Link Connection Identifier is 10-bit virtual circuit identifier. It is used to assign frames to the specified Permanent Virtual Circuits or Switched Virtual Circuits.

mcqs.question: Frame relay has only _______

options.c: c) physical layer and data link layer
options.d: d) network layer and data link layer

mcqs.answer: c) physical layer and data link layer
