However, if two routes are received and they both have the same AD, then the router will choose the one route with the lowest metrics, or in RIP’s case, hop count.

mcqs.question: You type debug IP rip on your router console and see that 172.16.10.0 is being advertised to you with a metric of 16. What does this mean?

options.a: a) The route is 16 hops away Debug IP rip
options.b: b) The route has a delay of 16 microseconds Debug IP route
options.d: d) The route is queued at 16 messages a second

mcqs.explanation: You cannot have 16 hops on a RIP network by default, because the max default hops possible is 15. If you receive a route advertised with a metric of 16, this means it is inaccessible.

mcqs.question: Default administrative distance of a static route is ________
mcqs.explanation: 1 is the default administrative distance of Static Route. It is used by routers to select the best path when there are different routes to the same destination. It’s used only two different routing protocols are being used.

mcqs.question: Which protocol gives a full route table update every 30 seconds?
mcqs.explanation: RIP gives a full route table update every 30 seconds. The broadcasted routing table can be used by other routers to find the shortest path among the network devices.

mcqs.question: _________ is the default administrative distance of RIP.
mcqs.explanation: The default administrative distance is the default count of numbers assigned to arbitrary routes to a destination. The default administrative distance of RIP is 120. It is used to find the shortest route amongst the number of paths available.

mcqs.question: Which statement is true regarding classless routing protocol?

options.a: a) The use of discontinuous networks is not allowed
options.b: b) Use of variable length subnet masks is permitted
options.c: c) RIPv1 is a classless routing protocol
options.d: d) IGRP supports classes routing within the same autonomous system

mcqs.answer: b) Use of variable length subnet masks is permitted
mcqs.explanation: Use of variable length subnet masks is permitted in classless routing protocols. Also use of discontinuous networks is allowed in such routing protocols. RIPv1 is a classful routing protocol but RIPv2 is classless routing protocol.

mcqs.question: Where should we use default routing?

options.a: a) On stub networks- which have only one exit path out of the network
options.b: b) Which have more than one exit path out of the network
options.c: c) Minimum five exit paths out of the network
options.d: d) Maximum five exit paths out of the network

mcqs.answer: a) On stub networks- which have only one exit path out of the network
mcqs.explanation: We must use default routing on stub networks. They have only one exit path out of the network, so there can be no specific path decided for such networks.

links.context: This set of Computer Networks Multiple Choice Questions & Answers focuses on “RIP v2”.

mcqs.question: Which statement is true regarding classless routing protocols?

options.a: a) The use of discontinuous networks is not allowed
options.b: b) The use of variable length subnet masks is permitted
options.c: c) RIPv1 is a classless routing protocol

mcqs.answer: b) The use of variable length subnet masks is permitted
mcqs.explanation: Classful routing means that all hosts in the internetwork use the same mask. Classless routing means that you can use Variable Length Subnet Masks (VLSMs) and can also support discontinuous networking.

mcqs.question: What is route poisoning?

options.a: a) It sends back the protocol received from a router as a poison pill, which stops the regular updates. The use of variable length subnet masks is permitted
options.b: b) It is information received from a router that can’t be sent back to the originating router.RIPv2 supports classless routing
options.c: c) It prevents regular update messages from reinstating a route that has just come up
options.d: d) It describes when a router sets the metric for a downed link to infinity

mcqs.answer: d) It describes when a router sets the metric for a downed link to infinity
mcqs.explanation: When a network goes down, the distance-vector routing protocol initiates route poisoning by advertising the network with a metric of 16, or unreachable.

mcqs.question: Which of the following is true regarding RIPv2?

options.a: a) It has a lower administrative distance than RIPv1
options.b: b) It converges faster than RIPv1
options.c: c) It has the same timers as RIPv1
options.d: d) It is harder to configure than RIPv1

mcqs.answer: c) It has the same timers as RIPv1
mcqs.explanation: RIPv2 is pretty much just like RIPv1. It has the same administrative distance and timers and is configured just like RIPv1.

mcqs.question: Which of the situations might not require multiple routing protocols in a network?

options.a: a) When a new Layer 2-only switch is added to the network
options.b: b) When you are migrating from one routing protocol to another
options.c: c) When you are using routers from multiple vendors
options.d: d) When there are host-based routers from multiple vendors

mcqs.answer: a) When a new Layer 2-only switch is added to the network
mcqs.explanation: Multiple routing protocols are required only when we need to migrate from one routing protocol to another, or when we are using routers from multiple vendors, or when there are host-based routers from multiple vendors. Routing is not a layer-2 function so we don’t require multiple routing protocols when new layer-2 switch is added.

mcqs.question: Which two routing protocols can be redistributed into OSPF by a Cisco router?

options.a: a) IP EIGRP and AppleTalk EIGRP

mcqs.explanation: OSPF stands for Open Shortest Path First. It is a Link state routing protocol. IP EIGRP and RIPv2 can be redistributed into OSPF by a Cisco router.

mcqs.question: Which is a reason for avoiding doing route redistribution on two routers between the same two routing domains?

options.a: a) Higher cost of two routers
options.d: d) Not possible to use two routers

mcqs.explanation: Routing feedback is an anomaly in which the routing protocols go back and forth between one route and another. Routing feedback is a reason for avoiding doing route redistribution on two routers between the same two routing domains.

mcqs.question: What does administrative distance rank?
mcqs.explanation: Sources of routing information is the administrative distance rank. It is used by routers to select the best path when there are different routes to the same destination. It’s used only two different routing protocols are being used.

mcqs.question: Which protocol maintains neighbor adjacencies?
mcqs.explanation: Neighbor adjacency refers to the formal handshake performed by neighboring routers. It is to be done before the router share any routing information. RIP V2 maintains neighbor adjacencies.

mcqs.question: Which routing protocol implements the diffusing update algorithm?
mcqs.explanation: The diffusing update algorithm (DUAL) is used to maintain backup routes to a destination for when the primary route fails. EIGRP routing protocol implements the diffusing update algorithm.

links.context:
This set of Computer Networks Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Cryptography”.

Technical Primer for this Topic: Cryptography

mcqs.question: In cryptography, what is cipher?

options.a: a) algorithm for performing encryption and decryption
options.c: c) both algorithm for performing encryption and decryption and encrypted message

mcqs.answer: a) algorithm for performing encryption and decryption
mcqs.explanation: Cipher is a method to implement encryption and decryption of messages travelling in a network. It’s used to increase the confidentiality of the messages.

mcqs.question: In asymmetric key cryptography, the private key is kept by __________

options.d: d) all the connected devices to the network

mcqs.explanation: The private key is kept only by the receiver of the message. Its aim is to make sure that only the intended receiver can decipher the message.

mcqs.question: Which one of the following algorithm is not used in asymmetric-key cryptography?
mcqs.explanation: Electronic code book algorithm is a block cipher method in which each block of text in an encrypted message corresponds to a block of data. It is not feasible for block sizes smaller than 40 bits.

mcqs.question: In cryptography, the order of the letters in a message is rearranged by __________

options.c: c) both transpositional ciphers and substitution ciphers

mcqs.explanation: In transposition ciphers, the order of letters in a plaintext message is shuffled using a pre-defined method. Some of such ciphers are Rail fence cipher and Columnar transposition.

mcqs.question: What is data encryption standard (DES)?
mcqs.explanation: DES is a symmetric key block cipher in which the block size is 64 bits and the key size is 64 bits. It is vulnerable to some attacks and is hence not that popularly used.

mcqs.question: Cryptanalysis is used __________

options.a: a) to find some insecurity in a cryptographic scheme

mcqs.answer: a) to find some insecurity in a cryptographic scheme
mcqs.explanation: Cryptanalysis is a field of study in which a cryptographic scheme is intentionally tried to breach in order to find flaws and insecurities. It is used to make sure that the scheme is least vulnerable to attacks.

mcqs.question: Which one of the following is a cryptographic protocol used to secure HTTP connection?
mcqs.explanation: TLS has strong message authentication and key-material generation to prevent eavesdropping, tampering and message forgery. It has been used since the year 1996.

mcqs.question: Voice privacy in GSM cellular telephone protocol is provided by _______
mcqs.explanation: The A5/2 cipher was published in the year 1996 and was cryptanalysed in the same year within a month. It’s use was discontinued from the year 2006 as it was really weak.

mcqs.question: ElGamal encryption system is __________
mcqs.explanation: The ELGamal encryption system was made by Taher Elgamal in the year 1985 and is an asymmetric key algorithm. It is popularly used in PGP and other systems.

mcqs.question: Cryptographic hash function takes an arbitrary block of data and returns _________

options.c: c) both fixed size bit string and variable size bit string

mcqs.explanation: Cryptographic hash functions are used in digital signatures and message authentication codes. The only issue with it is that it returns the same hash value every time for a message making it vulnerable to attackers to evaluate and break the cipher.

links.context: This set of Computer Networks Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Ports”.

mcqs.question: Multiple objects can be sent over a TCP connection between client and server in a persistent HTTP connection.
mcqs.explanation: Persistent connections are kept active after completing transaction so that multiple objects can be sent over the same TCP connection.

mcqs.question: HTTP is ________ protocol.
mcqs.explanation: HTTP is an Application layer protocol used to define how messages are formatted and transmitted through the World Wide Web.

mcqs.question: In the network HTTP resources are located by __________
mcqs.explanation: The Uniform Resource Identifier is a name and locator for the resource to be located by the HTTP. The URLs and URNs are derived through the identifier.

mcqs.question: HTTP client requests by establishing a __________ connection to a particular port on the server.
mcqs.explanation: HTTP clients perform requests using a TCP connection, because the TCP connection provides a more reliable service. UDP is not a reliable protocol, border gateway protocol is used on top of TCP, while domain host control protocol is a network layer protocol.

mcqs.question: In HTTP pipelining __________

options.a: a) multiple HTTP requests are sent on a single TCP connection without waiting for the corresponding responses
options.b: b) multiple HTTP requests cannot be sent on a single TCP connection
options.c: c) multiple HTTP requests are sent in a queue on a single TCP connection
options.d: d) multiple HTTP requests are sent at random on a single TCP connection

mcqs.answer: a) multiple HTTP requests are sent on a single TCP connection without waiting for the corresponding responses
mcqs.explanation: HTTP pipelining helps the client make multiple requests without having to waiting for each response, thus saving a lot of time and bandwidth for the client.

mcqs.question: FTP server listens for connection on which port number?
mcqs.explanation: FTP server listens on port 21 for connection request whereas port 20 is used for FTP data transfer. Port 22 is used for SSH remote login. Port 23 is used for TELNET.

mcqs.question: In FTP protocol, a client contacts a server using ______ as the transport protocol.
mcqs.explanation: The clients use the Transmission Control Protocol for FTP as it’s more reliable than UDP, DCCP, and SCTP, and reliability of file transfer is required to be as high as possible for FTP.

mcqs.question: In Active mode FTP, the client initiates both the control and data connections.
mcqs.explanation: In Passive mode of FTP, the client initiates both data and control connections, while in Active mode, the client initiates the control connection and then the server initiates the data connection.

mcqs.question: The File Transfer Protocol is built on __________
mcqs.explanation: The FTP connection includes a Server and a Client which wish to share files. The server can have multiple clients at the same time while the client communicates with only one server at a time.

mcqs.question: In File Transfer Protocol, data transfer cannot be done in __________
mcqs.explanation: In Stream mode, the data is transferred in a continuous stream. In Block mode, data is transferred after being divided into smaller blocks. In Compressed mode, data is transferred after being compressed using some compression algorithm.

links.context: This set of Computer Networks Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Socket Programming”.

mcqs.question: Which methods are commonly used in Server Socket class?

options.a: a) Public Output Stream get Output Stream ()

mcqs.explanation: The Public socket accept () method is used by the ServerSocket class to accept the connection request of exactly one client at a time. The client requests by initializing the socket object with the servers IP address.

mcqs.question: Which constructor of Datagram Socket class is used to create a datagram socket and binds it with the given Port Number?

options.b: b) Datagram Socket(int port, Int Address address)

mcqs.answer: b) Datagram Socket(int port, Int Address address)
mcqs.explanation: Datagram Socket (int port, Int Address address) is used to create a datagram socket. A datagram socket is created for connection-less communication between the server and the client. There is no accept() method in this class.

mcqs.question: The client in socket programming must know which information?

options.c: c) Both IP address of Server & Port number
options.d: d) Only its own IP address

mcqs.answer: c) Both IP address of Server & Port number
mcqs.explanation: The client in socket programming must know IP address of Server as it has to use that IP address in order to initialize the socket class constructor. That is how the client requests a connection to the server.

mcqs.question: The URL Connection class can be used to read and write data to the specified resource that is referred by the URL.
mcqs.explanation: The URL Connection class can be used to read and write data to the specified resource referred by the URL. A connection to the URL is initialized by the OpenConnection() method of the class.

mcqs.question: Datagram is basically just a piece of information but there is no guarantee of its content, arrival or arrival time.
mcqs.explanation: Datagram is basically some information travelling between the sender and the receiver, but there is no guarantee of its content, arrival or arrival time. A Datagram socket class object is created to make a datagram connection between the server and the client.

mcqs.question: TCP, FTP, Telnet, SMTP, POP etc. are examples of ___________
mcqs.explanation: TCP, FTP, Telnet, SMTP, POP etc. are examples of Protocol. Out of them, TCP is a transport layer protocol and FTP, TELNET, SMTP and POP are application layer protocols.

mcqs.question: What does the java.net.InetAddress class represent?
mcqs.explanation: The java.net.InetAddress class represents IP Address of a particular specified host. It can be used to resolve the host name from the IP address or the IP address from the host name.

mcqs.question: The flush () method of Print Stream class flushes any un-cleared buffers in the memory.
mcqs.explanation: The flush () method of Print Stream class flushes any un cleared buffers in memory.

mcqs.question: Which classes are used for connection-less socket programming?

options.c: c) Both Datagram Socket & Datagram Packet

mcqs.answer: c) Both Datagram Socket & Datagram Packet
mcqs.explanation: Datagram is basically some information travelling between the sender and the receiver, but there is no guarantee of its content, arrival or arrival time. Datagram Socket, Datagram Packet are used for connection-less socket programming, while Server Socket is used for connection-oriented socket programming.

mcqs.question: In Inet Address class, which method returns the host name of the IP Address?

options.c: c) Public static InetAddress get Localhost()

mcqs.explanation: In Inet Address class public String getHostname() method returns the host name of the IP Address. The getHostAddress() method returns the IP address of the given host name.

links.context: This set of Computer Networks Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Cookies”.

mcqs.question: Cookies were originally designed for ____________

options.c: c) Both Client side programming and Server side programming

mcqs.explanation: Cookies were originally designed for server side programming, and at the lowest level, they are implemented as an extension to the HTTP protocol. They were introduced with the intention of providing a better user experience for the websites.

mcqs.question: The Cookie manipulation is done using which property?
mcqs.explanation: The cookie property sets or returns all name/value pairs of cookies in the current document. There are no methods involved: cookies are queried, set, and deleted by reading and writing the cookie property of the Document object using specially formatted strings.

mcqs.question: Which of the following explains Cookies nature?
mcqs.explanation: Cookies are transient by default; the values they store last for the duration of the web browser session but are lost when the user exits the browser. While the browsing session is active the cookie stores the user values in the user’s storage itself and accesses them.

mcqs.question: Which attribute is used to extend the lifetime of a cookie?
mcqs.explanation: If you want a cookie to last beyond a single browsing session, you must tell the browser how long (in seconds) you would like it to retain the cookie by specifying a max-age attribute. A number of seconds until the cookie expires. A zero or negative number will kill the cookie immediately.

mcqs.question: Which of the following defines the Cookie visibility?
mcqs.explanation: sessionStorage, localStorage and Document path all are used to store data on the client-side. Each one has its own storage and expiration limit. Cookie visibility is scoped by the document origin as Local Storage and Session Storage are, and also by document path.

mcqs.question: Which of the following can be used to configure the scope of the Cookie visibility?
mcqs.explanation: The Cookie visibility scope is configurable through cookie attributes path and domain. Domain attribute in the cookie is used to specify the domain for which the cookie is sent. Path includes the Path attribute in the cookie to specify the path for which this cookie is sent.

mcqs.question: How can you set a Cookie visibility scope to local Storage?
mcqs.explanation: Setting the path of a cookie to “/” gives scoping like that of localStorage and also specifies that the browser must transmit the cookie name and value to the server whenever it requests any web page on the site.

mcqs.question: Which of the following is a Boolean cookie attribute?
mcqs.explanation: The final cookie attribute is a boolean attribute named secure that specifies how cookie values are transmitted over the network. By default, cookies are insecure, which means that they are transmitted over a normal, insecure HTTP connection. If a cookie is marked secure, however, it is transmitted only when the browser and server are connected via HTTPS or another secure protocol.

mcqs.question: Which of the following function is used as a consequence of not including semicolons, Commas or whitespace in the Cookie value?
mcqs.explanation: Cookie values cannot include semicolons, commas, or whitespace. For this reason, you may want to use the core JavaScript global function encodeURIComponent() to encode the value before storing it in the cookie.

mcqs.question: What is the constraint on the data per cookie?
mcqs.explanation: Each cookie can hold up to only 4 KB. In practice, browsers allow many more than 300 cookies total, but the 4 KB size limit may still be enforced by some. Storage of a session has to be a minimum of 5MB.

links.context: This set of Computer Networks Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Web Caching”.

mcqs.question: What does REST stand for?
mcqs.explanation: REST stands for Representational State Transfer and is a software architecture style in which the server sends a representation of the state of the resource that it requests. It provides interoperability between the systems.

mcqs.question: Which of the following protocol is used by Restful web services as a medium of communication between client and server?
mcqs.explanation: Restful web services make use of HTTP protocol as a medium of communication between client and server. The REST architecture was known as the HTTP object model back in the year 1994.

mcqs.question: Which of the following is not a good practice to create a standard URI for a web service?

options.c: c) Using spaces for long resource names

mcqs.answer: c) Using spaces for long resource names
mcqs.explanation: We must use hyphens (-) or underscores (_) instead of spaces to represent long resource names. It may lead to the resource to be less recognizable for the system if we use spaces instead.

mcqs.question: Which of the following HTTP methods should be idempotent in nature?
mcqs.explanation: DELETE operation should be idempotent, means their result will always same no matter how many times these operations are invoked. Also, the PUT operation is supposed to be idempotent.

mcqs.question: Which of the following directive of Cache Control Header of HTTP response indicates that resource is cachable by only client and server?
mcqs.explanation: Private directive indicates that resource is cachable by only client and server; no intermediary can cache the resource. But if we use the public directive, it indicates that the resource may be cachable by any intermediary component.

mcqs.question: Which of the following HTTP Status code means CREATED, when a resource is successful created using POST or PUT request?
mcqs.explanation: HTTP Status Code 201 means CREATED, when a resource is successful created using POST or PUT request. The code 200 means success i.e. OK, code 204 means NO CONTENT, and the code 304 means NOT MODIFIED.

mcqs.question: Which of the following annotation of JAX RS API is used to annotate a method used to create resource?
mcqs.explanation: @PUT is the HTTP request that is used to create resource and also define a complete resource path. @POST may also be used to create a resource but it won’t define a resource path i.e. an accessing medium.

mcqs.question: Which of the following annotation of JAX RS API binds the parameter passed to method to a HTTP matrix parameter in path?
mcqs.explanation: @MatrixParam is the annotation that binds the parameter passed to method to a HTTP matrix parameter in path, while @QueryParam binds to a query parameter, @PathParam binds to a value and @HeaderParam binds to the HTTP header in the path.

mcqs.question: In REST architecture, a REST Server simply provides access to resources and REST client accesses and presents the resources.
mcqs.explanation: In REST architecture, a REST Server simply provides access to resources and REST client accesses and presents the resources. It is popularly used because it makes efficient use of the bandwidth and can be cached for better performance and scalability.

mcqs.question: POST operation should be idempotent.
mcqs.explanation: POST operation can cause different result so they are not idempotent. The DELETE and PUT operations are idempotent as they invoke the same result every time they are called.

links.context: This set of Computer Networks Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Packet Forwarding and Routing”.

mcqs.question: The term that is used to place packet in its route to its destination is called __________
mcqs.explanation: Forwarding is done by the nodes in the path from source to destination, that are not the intended destination for the packet in order to pass the packet to the next node in the path. The destination machine does not forward the packet to any other node.

mcqs.question: A second technique to reduce routing table and simplify searching process is called _________
mcqs.explanation: In the network specific forwarding method, there is only one record, the destination of the packet, in the routing table and not the other hosts of the network. The other two forwarding methods are the default method and the next-hop method.

mcqs.question: Next-Hop Method is used to reduce contents of a _________
mcqs.explanation: In the next-hop forwarding method, the routing table of each router in the path contains the address of only the next hop in the path of packet. This method is suitable for short distances only.

mcqs.question: Several techniques can make size of routing table manageable and also handle issues such as __________
mcqs.explanation: The size of the routing table in the technique must be manageable for the network nodes i.e. it must not be too big. Security of the forwarding packet is the highest priority for a technique and must be high enough so that only authorized senders and receivers can access the packet’s content.

mcqs.question: Host-specific routing is used for purposes such as checking route or providing _____
mcqs.explanation: In host-specific routing, the route of the packet is defined based on the exact match of the packet’s IP with the routing table entry of the host. It provides the best security for the packet as the packet is forwarded only to routers in the pre-defined path.

mcqs.question: In Unicast routing, if instability is between three nodes, stability cannot be ________
mcqs.explanation: In Unicast routing, there is only sender and one receiver. So, if there is instability between three nodes, in which one is sender, one is receiver and one is the router in the path, there is no other path available for the packet and the stability of the network is not guaranteed.

mcqs.question: In Unicast Routing, Dijkstra algorithm creates a shortest path tree from a ________
mcqs.explanation: The Djikstra’s shortest path algorithm is the fastest among the algorithms for finding the shortest path in a graph. But it is a greedy method based algorithm so it does not guarantee the shortest path every time.

mcqs.question: In Multicast Routing Protocol, flooding is used to broadcast packets but it creates ________
mcqs.explanation: In multicast routing, there is one sender and many receivers. So flooding is the most basic method to forward packets to many receivers. The one issue with flooding is that it creates routing loops. One loop prevention method is that the routers will not send the packet to a node where the packet has been received before.

mcqs.question: RPF stands for __________
mcqs.explanation: Reverse Path Forwarding is a loop-free forwarding method for multi-cast routing in modern systems. The method focuses on forwarding the packet away from the source IP in each iteration to make sure there is no loops.

mcqs.question: LSP stands for __________
mcqs.explanation: A Link State Packet is a packet created by a router that lists its neighboring nodes and routers in link state routing protocol. It is shared with other routers to find the shortest path from a source to the destination.

links.context: This set of Computer Networks Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “CIDR”.

mcqs.question: The CIDR value represents ____________

options.a: a) Number of bits in the network
options.b: b) Number of total bits in the IP address
options.c: c) Number of bits in the host

mcqs.answer: a) Number of bits in the network
mcqs.explanation: The CIDR value represents the number of bits in the network. These CIDR values are represented by ‘/’ at the end of the network Id.

mcqs.question: Which class does the IP address 192.168.10.5/24 represent?
mcqs.explanation: The IP address 192.168.10.5/24 represents Class C because the CIDR value of Class C is 24; i.e. Class C has 24 bits in the network portion.

mcqs.question: The CIDR value affects the subnet mask of an IP address.
mcqs.explanation: Yes, as CIDR value represents the number of bits in the network, hence it can also be used to calculate the number of bits in the host portion doing so will also determine the subnet mask of the IP address. Hence CIDR value affects the subnet mask of an IP address.

mcqs.question: When was the CIDR system created?
mcqs.explanation: The CIDR system was introduced in 1993 along with the IPv4 standard. During 1988, 1998 and 2006 IANA, APIPA and new IPv4 standards were introduced respectively.

mcqs.question: Private IPs are calculated using CIDR values.
mcqs.explanation: Private IPs are assigned by IANA. CIDR values are used to calculate the subnet mask and range of a given IP address. CIDR values are used by network administrators to create and manage different subnets. Private IPs, on the other hand, are used by companies to create their network.

mcqs.question: Determine the number of subnets for the given IP 192.13.67.0/28 using the CIDR value.
mcqs.explanation:
Given,
CIDR value = 28
IP address = 192.13.67.0 (Class C)
The default number of bits in the network portion = 24
Let n be the number of bits added to the network portion of the given IP address
n = CIDR value – Default number of bits in the network portion
n = 28 – 24
n = 4
Number of Subnets = 2n
= 24
Number of Subnets = 16

mcqs.question: Determine the number of valid host IPs in each subnet for the given IP 172.16.0.0/25 using the CIDR value.
mcqs.explanation:
Given,
CIDR value = 25
IP address = 172.16.0.0 (Class B)
Total number of bits in an IP address = 32
Let n be the number of bits in the host portion of the given IP address
n = Total number of bits in an IP address – CIDR value
n = 32 – 25
n = 7
Number of Hosts = 2n – 2
= 27 – 2
Number of Hosts = 128 -2
Number of Hosts = 126
Since Network IP and Broadcast IP cannot be assigned to any host we remove those 2 IPs.

mcqs.question: Determine the total number of valid IPs in each subnet for the given IP 192.168.10.0/26 using the CIDR value.
mcqs.explanation:
Given,
CIDR value = 26
IP address = 192.168.10.0 (Class C)
Total number of bits in an IP address = 32
Let n be the number of bits in the host portion of the given IP address
n = Total number of bits in an IP address – CIDR value
n = 32 – 26
n = 6
Total number of valid IPs in a subnet = 2n
= 26
Total number of valid IPs in a subnet = 64.

links.context: This set of Computer Networks Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “VLAN”.

mcqs.question: Physical partitioning of a switch can create virtual local area networks.
mcqs.explanation: Virtual local area networks can be created by dividing the switch logically. Virtual local area networks reduce the number of devices as they use a single switch for multiple local area networks.

mcqs.question: Which of the following cannot be considered as characteristic to create virtual local area networks using switch?

options.a: a) Port numbers of the switch
options.b: b) IP addresses of the stations
options.c: c) Port numbers of the stations
options.d: d) MAC addresses of the stations

mcqs.answer: c) Port numbers of the stations
mcqs.explanation: Port number of a station cannot be considered as a characteristic to partition a switch, because a single station may have multiple port. Remaining all characteristics are unique to identify each station individually.

mcqs.question: Which method(s) can be used to establish communication between two different virtual area networks?

options.b: b) Frame tagging and table maintenance
options.d: d) TDM, frame tagging and table maintenance

mcqs.answer: d) TDM, frame tagging and table maintenance
mcqs.explanation: Communication between two virtual area networks can be possible using a router or backbone switch. When back bone switch is used, then any one of the three methods can be used to establish communication between different VLANs.

mcqs.question: Why is it important to add VLAN identifiers to the frames when they move from one VLAN to another VLAN?

options.a: a) To identify which VLAN they belong to
options.b: b) To identify which switch they belong to
options.c: c) To identify which host they belong to
options.d: d) To identify which router they belong to

mcqs.answer: a) To identify which VLAN they belong to
mcqs.explanation: Generally, no host knows to which VLAN it belongs to and it is the switch who takes the responsibility of tagging VLAN identifiers to frames. Before placing a packet on the trunk link, the packet should have VLAN identifier to be identified uniquely.

mcqs.question: What can be achieved by partitioning the whole local area network into virtual local area networks?

options.b: b) Security, cost reduction, efficiency and application management
options.d: d) Security, cost reduction and efficiency

mcqs.answer: b) Security, cost reduction, efficiency and application management
mcqs.explanation: Main purpose of VLANs is providing security. Along with security it reduces the cost by reducing usage of many devices, improves efficiency and it makes application easy to maintain.

mcqs.question: Which of the following is a disadvantage of virtual local area network?
mcqs.explanation: In VLAN hooping an attacker can access all the VLANs. The attacker gets the access by penetrating other VLANs with traffic. There are two ways to do this hooping, they are switch spoofing and double tagging.

mcqs.question: What is the normal virtual area network range?
mcqs.explanation: VLAN 2-1001 is a normal range where we can create the VLANs. These VLANs are editable means we can create, delete and update. Actually 1-4094 is the complete valid range to create the VLANs.

mcqs.question: Which VLAN receives a frame that does not contain a VLAN tag?
mcqs.explanation: When a switch encounters a frame without a VALN tag, then it routes the frame to the native VLAN. Basically, a native VLAN is VLAN1. But it is not advisable to let the VLAN1 be a native VLAN.

mcqs.question: In how many ways stations can be configured to be grouped into different virtual local area networks?
mcqs.explanation: VLAN configuration uses VLAN software and in that software, if we type all the addresses then it is manual. If a particular criterion is used to create the VLAN then it is automatic. In semi-automatic, we use manual configuration only for initializing.

mcqs.question: How many bits are required to represent a virtual local area network identifier in an ethernet frame?
mcqs.explanation: VLAN identifier occupies 12 bits in a frame tag to be distinguished from other VLANs. A tag field is present in between a source MAC address and ethernet type in the ethernet frame. This tag contains VLAN identifier.

links.context:
This set of Computer Networks Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Security In The Internet”.

Foundational Reading for this Topic: Network Security

mcqs.question: IPSec is designed to provide security at the _________
mcqs.explanation: IPSec is a set of protocols used to provide authentication, data integrity and confidentiality between two machines in an IP network. In the TCP/IP model, it provides security at the IP layer i.e. the network layer.

mcqs.question: In tunnel mode, IPSec protects the ______
mcqs.explanation: In the tunnel mode, IPSec adds control bits into the packets to encrypt the entire packet between the IPSec endpoints. Using encryption, it provides secure communication between the two endpoints.

mcqs.question: Network layer firewall works as a ________
mcqs.explanation: As you know, firewalls are available as hardware appliances, as software-only, or a combination of the two. In every case, the purpose of a firewall is to isolate your trusted internal network (or your personal PC) from the dangers of unknown resources on the Internet and other network connections that may be harmful. The firewall prevents unauthorized access to your internal, trusted network from outside threats.

mcqs.question: Network layer firewall has two sub-categories called ____________

options.a: a) stateful firewall and stateless firewall
options.b: b) bit oriented firewall and byte oriented firewall
options.c: c) frame firewall and packet firewall
options.d: d) network firewall and data firewall

mcqs.answer: a) stateful firewall and stateless firewall
mcqs.explanation: Most network layer firewalls can operate as stateful or stateless firewalls, creating two subcategories of the standard network layer firewall. Stateful firewalls have the advantage of being able to track packets over a period of time for greater analysis and accuracy — but they require more memory and operate more slowly. Stateless firewalls do not analyze past traffic and can be useful for systems where speed is more important than security, or for systems that have very specific and limited needs. For example, a computer that only needs to connect to a particular backup server does not need the extra security of a stateful firewall.

mcqs.question: WPA2 is used for security in _______
mcqs.explanation: WPA2 or WiFi Protected Access 2 is a security protocol used to provide users and firms with strong data security and protection for their wireless networks (WiFi) to give them confidence that only authorized users can access their network.

mcqs.question: An attempt to make a computer resource unavailable to its intended users is called ______
mcqs.explanation: In a Denial of Service attack, the attacker won’t let the victims access the network by using a certain method that ensures that an essential network resource is unavailable to the victim. The methods that the attacker can use are vulnerability attack, bandwidth flooding and connection flooding.

mcqs.question: Extensible authentication protocol is authentication framework frequently used in ______
mcqs.explanation: The Extensible Authentication Protocol (EAP) is an authentication protocol used to connect a network node to the Internet. It designed through extending the methods used by the Point-to-Point Protocol for authentication.

mcqs.question: Pretty good privacy (PGP) is used in ______
mcqs.explanation: PGP is an encryption method used in e-mail security to encrypt and decrypt the content of an e-mail transmitted over the internet. It makes sure that the message cannot be stolen by other unauthorized users.

mcqs.question: PGP encrypts data by using a block cipher called ______
mcqs.explanation: The IDEA was designed in 1991 by Xuejia Lai and James Massey. Before IDEA, PGP used the cipher method BassOmatic.

mcqs.question: When a DNS server accepts and uses incorrect information from a host that has no authority giving that information, then it is called _________
mcqs.explanation: In DNS spoofing, also known as DNS cache poisoning, an attacker gets the valid credentials from a victim by spoofing the intended resource, and tricking the victim to give his/her valid authorization credentials.

links.context: This set of Computer Network Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Security Management “.

mcqs.question: _________ public key is the hybrid of secret and public key.
mcqs.explanation: The Diffie-Hellman public key algorithm is the oldest public key algorithm. It is a hybrid of the secret and public key.

mcqs.question: ________ of individual hosts are useful for identifying some hidden costs.
mcqs.explanation: Accounting management is probably the least developed function of the network management application. Accounting management could also include the use of individual hosts, administrative segments, and external traffic. Accounting of individual hosts is useful for identifying some hidden costs.

mcqs.question: Security management is both a/an _______ and a/an _______ issue in information management.
mcqs.explanation: Security management is both a technical and administrative issue in information management. It involves securing access to the network and information flowing in the network, access to data stored in the network, and manipulating the data that are stored and flowing across the network.

mcqs.question: The application gateway behaves differently for each application.
mcqs.explanation: An application-level gateway is used to overcome some of the problems identified in packet filtering. Firewalls F1 and F2 will only forward if data are to or from the application gateway. Thus, the secured LAN is a gateway LAN. The application gateway behaves differently for each application, and filtering is handled by the proxy services in the application gateway.

mcqs.question: Firewalls use _________ as the primary technique of controlling undesired traffic.
mcqs.explanation: The main purpose of a firewall is to protect a network from external attacks. It monitors and controls traffic into and out of a secure network. h can be implemented in a router, or a gateway or a special host. A firewall is normally located at the gateway to a network, but it may also be implemented at host access points. Firewalls use packet filtering or application-level gateways as the two primary techniques of controlling undesired traffic.

mcqs.question: The scope of network and access to security management covers only enterprise intranet network.
mcqs.explanation: Security management is both a technical and administrative issue in information management. It involves securing access to the network and information flowing in the network, access to data stored in the network, and manipulating the data that are stored and flowing across the network. The scope of network and access to it not only covers enterprise intranet network but also the Internet that it is connected to.

mcqs.question: Which among the following algorithms implement secret key?
mcqs.explanation: There are two standard algorithms implement secret key cryptography. They are Data Encryption Standard (DES) and International Data Encryption Algorithm (IDEA). DES is designed for efficient hardware implementation and consequently has a poor performance if implemented in software. In contrast to that, IDEA functions efficiently in software implementation.

mcqs.question: The ________ module in Pretty Good Privacy (PGP) uses MD5 to generate a hash code of the message and encrypts it with the sender’s private key using an RSA algorithm.
mcqs.explanation: Pretty Good Privacy (PGP) defines a clever procedure that utilizes various available modules to perform the functions needed to transmit a secure message, such as email. The signature generation module uses MD5 to generate a hash code of the message and encrypts it with the sender’s private key using an RSA algorithm.

mcqs.question: The encryption and decryption modules for secret key cryptography can be implemented only in hardware.
mcqs.explanation: In Secret Key Cryptography, each letter is replaced by another letter n letters later in the alphabet. It is the same key that is used for encryption and decryption and is called secret key cryptography. The encryption and decryption modules can be implemented in either hardware or software.

mcqs.question: What do you mean by integrity protection in Security management?

options.a: a) It makes sure that the information has not tampered as it traverses between the source and the destination
options.b: b) It validates the originator identification
options.c: c) It is used to overcome some of the problems identified in packet filtering
options.d: d) It reduces the risk of access to hosts from an external network by filtering insecure services

mcqs.answer: a) It makes sure that the information has not tampered as it traverses between the source and the destination
mcqs.explanation: For secure communication, we need to ensure integrity protection and authentication validation. Integrity protection makes sure that the information has not been tampered with as it traverses between the source and the destination.

title: 9. Multiple Choice Questions on Network Layer

links.context:
This set of Computer Networks Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “OSPF”.

Foundational Reading for this Topic: Open Shortest Path First (OSPF) Protocol

mcqs.question: Open Shortest Path First (OSPF) is also called as _____________
mcqs.explanation: In OSPF, the link state of each path is checked, and then the shortest path is chosen among only the open state links. Each OSPF router monitors the cost of the link to each of its neighbors and then floods the link state information to other routers in the network.

mcqs.question: The computation of the shortest path in OSPF is usually done by ____________
mcqs.explanation: Shortest path in OSPF is usually computed by Dijkstra’s algorithm. It was proposed by Edsger W. Dijkstra in the year 1956. It is a greedy method algorithm and hence may not guarantee the shortest path every time, but is really fast.

mcqs.question: Which of the following is false with respect to the features of OSPF?

options.a: a) Support for fixed-length subnetting by including the subnet mask in the routing message
options.b: b) More flexible link cost than can range from 1 to 65535
options.d: d) Distribution of traffic over multiple paths that have equal cost to the destination

mcqs.answer: a) Support for fixed-length subnetting by including the subnet mask in the routing message
mcqs.explanation: OSPF provides support for variable-length sunbathing by including the subnet mask in the routing message. For fixed length subnets, there is no requirement for including the subnet mask in the routing message as there is just one subnet mask for all the subnets.

mcqs.question: In OSPF, which protocol is used to discover neighbour routers automatically?
mcqs.explanation: Hello protocol is used to discover neighboring routers automatically. It makes sure that the communication between neighbors is bidirectional. It’s similar to the real world moral construct of saying “Hello” to initialize the communication.

mcqs.question: Which of the following is not a type of OSPF packet?
mcqs.explanation: The five types of OSPF packets are: Hello, Database description, Link-state request, Link-state update, and Link-state ACK. There is no Link-state response packet; the neighbor router sends a Link-state update packet as a response to the Link-state request packet if there is an update in the routing table.

mcqs.question:
What is the correct order of the operations of OSPF? i – Hello packets
ii – Propagation of link-state information and building of routing tables
iii – Establishing adjacencies and synchronization of database
mcqs.explanation: OSPF first implements a hello protocol. Then it later on tries to establish synchronisation with database. Later on building of routing tables is done.

mcqs.question: In OSPF header, which field is used to detect errors in the packet?
mcqs.explanation: Checksum field is used to detect errors. It makes sure that the data portions that are being sent are all in integrity. It can detect duplicated bits. Once an error is detected, the sender has to re-transmit the data as it won’t receive an acknowledgement.

mcqs.question: In OSPF database descriptor packet, if there are more database descriptor packets in the flow, ‘M’ field is set to ____________
mcqs.explanation: The “M” bit is the more bit, which indicates that there are more packets to be received in the descriptor packet flow whenever it is set to 1. There is also an “I” bit which indicates if the packet is first in the flow.

mcqs.question: In OSPF database descriptor packet, which field is used to indicate that the router is master?
mcqs.explanation: The MS bit is used to indicate if the origin of the packet is a master or a slave. If it is set to 1, the source of the packet is a master, and if it is set to 0, the source of the packet is a slave.

mcqs.question: In OSPF database descriptor packet, which field is used to detect a missing packet?
mcqs.explanation: Sequence number field is used to detect a missing packet. The packets are to be received in order of the sequence number, so if the receiver detects that there is a sequence number skipped or missing in the order, it stops processing the further received packets and informs the sender to retransmit the packets in sequence.

links.context:
This set of Computer Networks Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “OSPF Configuration”.

Foundational Reading for this Topic: Open Shortest Path First (OSPF) Protocol

mcqs.question: An OSPF router receives an LSA, the router checks its sequence number, and this number matches the sequence number of the LSA that the receiving router already has. What does the receiving router do with the LSA?

options.b: b) Adds it to the database
options.c: c) Sends newer LSU update to source router
options.d: d) Floods the LSA to the other routers

mcqs.explanation: When the OSPF router receives an LSA, the router checks its sequence number. If this number matches the sequence number of the LSA that the receiving router already has, the router ignores the LSA.

mcqs.question: An OSPF router receives an LSA. The router checks its sequence number and finds that this number is higher than the sequence number it already has. Which two tasks does the router perform with the LSA?

options.b: b) Adds it to the database
options.c: c) Sends newer LSU update to source router
options.d: d) Floods the LSA to the other routers

mcqs.answer: b) Adds it to the database
mcqs.explanation: An OSPF router receives an LSA. If the router checks its sequence number and finds that the number is higher than the sequence number of the LSA that it already has, the router adds it to the database, and then floods the LSA to the other routers.

mcqs.question: An OSPF router receives an LSA. The router checks its sequence number and finds that this number is lower than the sequence number it already has. What does the router do with the LSA?

options.b: b) adds it to the database
options.c: c) sends newer LSU update to source router
options.d: d) floods the LSA to the other routers

mcqs.answer: c) sends newer LSU update to source router
mcqs.explanation: An OSPF router receives an LSA. If the router checks its sequence number and finds that this number is lower than the sequence number that it already has, the router sends newer LSU update to source router. The router then adds it to the database and floods it to the other routers.

mcqs.question: Each LSA has its own age timer. By default, how long does an LSA wait before requiring an update?
mcqs.explanation: Each LSA has its own age timer. By default, an LSA waits for 30 minutes before requiring an update. The router then has to send a LSR (Link State Request) to its neighbors to get an update.

mcqs.question: Distance vector protocols use the concept of split horizon, but link-state routing protocols, such as OSPF, do not.
mcqs.explanation: In Distance vector routing protocols, there is a problem called count-to-infinity which occurs regularly. So, to make sure that it does not occur, the split horizon algorithm is used. There is no requirement for it in OSPF.

mcqs.question: The outcome of Dijkstra’s calculation is used to populate the __________
mcqs.explanation: The outcome of Djikstra’s calculation is the main source of entries in the routing table as it is the algorithm that is used to find the shortest path in OSPF. The calculations are done after receiving every new LSU.

mcqs.question: What is the IP protocol number for OSPF packets?
mcqs.explanation: 89 is the IP protocol number for OSPF packets. 86 is the protocol number for DGP, 76 is the protocol number for Backroom-SATNET-Monitoring and 20 is the protocol number for Host Monitoring Protocol.

mcqs.question: Which packet is NOT an OSPF packet type?
mcqs.explanation: LSU is the Link State Update packet, LSR is the Link State Request packet and DBD is the Database Descriptor packet in OSPF. Query packet is NOT an OSPF packet type.

mcqs.question: Which multicast address does the OSPF Hello protocol use?
mcqs.explanation: Hello protocol is used to discover neighboring routers automatically. It makes sure that the communication between neighbors is bidirectional. The multicast address that the OSPF Hello protocol uses is 224.0.0.5.

mcqs.question: The Hello protocol sends periodic updates to ensure that a neighbor relationship is maintained between adjacent routers.
mcqs.explanation: The Hello protocol sends periodic updates to ensure that a neighbor relationship is maintained between adjacent routers. It’s similar to the real world moral construct of saying “Hello” to initialize the communication.

mcqs.question: DBD packets are involved during which two states?
mcqs.explanation: DBD stands for Database Descriptor. DBD packets are involved during the two states Exstart and Exchange. In exstart, the master and the slaves are decided and in the exchange state, the DBD is exchanged among the neighbors.

mcqs.question: At which interval does OSPF refresh LSAs?
mcqs.explanation: Each LSA has its own age timer. By default, an LSA waits for 30 minutes before requiring an update. So to make sure that each router first has an up-to-date LSA, OSPF refreshes LSAs after every 1 hour.

mcqs.question: Which field is NOT a field within an OSPF packet header?
mcqs.explanation: The packet length field gives the length of the packet in bits. The Authentication type field gives the type of authentication used. The router ID field gives the ID of the source router of the packet. In an OSPF packet header, there is no field called Maxage time.

mcqs.question: Which two commands are required for basic OSPF configuration?
mcqs.explanation: The “Router ospf [process-id]” command enables OSPF routing protocol in the router and the “[Wildcard-mask] area [area-id]” command is used to select the interfaces that we want to include in the OSPF process. That is enough for the basic configuration of OSPF in a router.

mcqs.question: Which OSPF show command describes a list of OSPF adjacencies?
mcqs.explanation: The “Show ip ospf neighbor” command is the OSPF show command that can describe a list of OSPF adjacencies i.e. the list of adjacent nodes or neighbors. The router will only communicate with its neighbors directly.

links.context:
This set of Computer Networks Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “BGP”.

Prep Material for this Topic: Border Gateway Protocol (BGP)

mcqs.question: How many categories are present in the autonomous systems?
mcqs.explanation: Transit is the only AS that allows data traffic to go through it. Stub and multi-homed will have connections with single and multiple AS respectively and do not allow themselves to be a service provider to allow traffic across them.

mcqs.question: Why a border gateway protocol (BGP) session is used in between routers?

options.b: b) To send the AS path
options.c: c) To interchange the routing information
options.d: d) To communicate with other AS

mcqs.answer: c) To interchange the routing information
mcqs.explanation: Usually BGP uses TCP services while establishing the sessions between BGP routers. A session is more like a connecting link to exchange only the information of routing and these BGP sessions are persistent.

mcqs.question: Which type of BGP session can be established between 2 routers from different autonomous systems?
mcqs.explanation: E-BGP stands for external border gateway protocol and internal BGP sessions are used only within the AS. Unlike I-BGP, external BGP sessions are used to share and retrieve the routing information of the routers which belongs to different AS.

mcqs.question: What will happen if two networks choose the policy called peering in place of transit service that is given by a provider?
mcqs.explanation: The traffic that autonomous systems get when they do peering is low compared to the traffic that they get when they use provider. And also, the provider lets its other customers to know the path of these ASs and it leads to more traffic to these ASs.

mcqs.question: Why border gateway protocol is called as path vector protocol?

options.a: a) Router maintains table for each path
options.b: b) Router keeps track of the path
options.c: c) Router defines a path with prior knowledge
options.d: d) Router selects the shortest path

mcqs.answer: b) Router keeps track of the path
mcqs.explanation: Basically, intra-domain routing maintains the table for each destination with least cost or distance. But in BGP, metric is policy, so every router keeps track of the path like next hop and AS path. This path vector protocol avoids looping using path tracking.

mcqs.question: When is it prominent to use border gateway protocol?

options.a: a) When AS is not aware of path selection
options.b: b) When routers have less capacity
options.c: c) When autonomous system is stab AS
options.d: d) when autonomous system is transit AS

mcqs.answer: d) when autonomous system is transit AS
mcqs.explanation: Border gateway protocol is more useful when the AS is transit because BGP is capable of inter-domain routing. So, it can handle the data traffic well when the ASs are transit.

mcqs.question: How a path can be defined in border gateway protocol?
mcqs.explanation: When traffic is sent from one network to another network, then every router within the route checks the path. This path contains not only the number of AS but also contains attributes that give information about the path such as next_hop.

mcqs.question: What are the two broad categories of attributes of a path in border gateway protocol?
mcqs.explanation: Well known and optional are two major categories of attributes. Mandatory and discretionary are categories of well-known attribute. Optional attribute also has two categories called transitive and non-transitive.

mcqs.question: Which of the following is not a well-known mandatory attribute of path in border gateway protocol?
mcqs.explanation: Origin defines the source of the packet and As_path defines the sequence of ASs that a packet follows and Next_hop defines about the next router that a packet is going to visit.

mcqs.question: Border gateway protocol is used within the Autonomous systems just like IGP protocols work.
mcqs.explanation: IGP protocols are intra-domain protocols, whereas BGP is an inter-domain protocol. It works among the autonomous systems which are owned by individual administrations rather than working within the autonomous system.

links.context: This set of Computer Networks Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Broadcast Routing”.

mcqs.question: Which application is not suitable to use broadcast routing?
mcqs.explanation: Telephone network uses hierarchical routing and broadcasting cannot be used in this. Because broadcast routing is suitable for those applications in which, each packet is sent to broad range of destinations. But telephone network has small number of receivers.

mcqs.question: Which of the following sentence is incorrect about broadcast routing?
mcqs.explanation: It does not use bandwidth efficiently, if only a few destinations are interested in broadcast packets, so bandwidth will be wasted. Also, it increases the traffic in the network and slows down the system.

mcqs.question: What kind of relation is in between source and destination in broadcast routing?
mcqs.explanation: Broadcast routing is mostly used in those applications, where one packet is received by all destinations, like live streaming of one event is viewed by many people. It cannot be one-to-many because, it does not maintain groups like multicast routing.

mcqs.question: Which of the following server is used to simulate the broadcast process while broadcast routing is being used?
mcqs.explanation: Broadcast unknown server will receive the broadcast frame and makes copies of it. And then, sends the copies to every station by initiating the process of broadcast routing.

links.context: This set of Computer Networks Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Hierarchical Routing”.

mcqs.question: Which of the following routing saves more memory in case of storing information about routers in the network?
mcqs.explanation: Unlike other routing tables, the routing tables in hierarchical routing will have entries for their neighbour within the region and entry for each region in the network. Also, this levelling in storing entries, saves the memory of the router in case of large network.

mcqs.question: Which name is used for the parts in the network that are divided by hierarchical routing in two level hierarchy?
mcqs.explanation: Regions are small parts of the network with dedicated number of routers and these regions can be grouped to form clusters. Clusters can be grouped to form zones, zones into groups. A network can be levelled with names until we run short of names.

mcqs.question: What is the number of entries in a router, if it belongs to a region with 11 routers and the network has 5 regions?
mcqs.explanation: The routing table will have total number of 15 entries for 11 routers, which belongs to the same region. And 4 entries for the regions other than the one in which the router is present.

mcqs.question: Routers in the hierarchical routing stores the information about every other router in the network?
mcqs.explanation: Hierarchical routing is to divide the network into tiers that are regions, clusters, zones, groups and so on. Because of this hierarchy, the router need not to have entries for every router in the network. And, it is enough to have entries for routers from the same region and each entry for; clusters, zones, groups, depending on the level of hierarchy.

mcqs.question: What is the optimum number of levels(hierarchical) that are required for a network if it has M number of routers?
mcqs.explanation: A network with “ln M” levels and “e ln M” entries for each router can be treated as optimum in levelling. This was discovered by Kamoun and Kleinrock in 1979.

mcqs.question: How many entries will be in router4 in the given network if it uses hierarchical routing?
mcqs.explanation: The above network is using hierarchical network. So, the router4 will have one entry for itself and two entries for the other two regions. It will have the entry for itself in its routing table even though it is the only router in the region.

mcqs.question: A network with two level hierarchy has total of 1600 routers and got divided into some parts, a router in the first part which consists of 500 routers has 503 entries in it. The second part and third part have routers with 303 and 603 entries respectively. What is the total no of regions in the network and how many routers are present in each part?
mcqs.explanation: Network has two level hierarchy and router in the first part has 3 extra entries more than the number of routers in that part. This indicates that the network has divided into 4 parts. After subtracting 500, 300 and 600 from 1600, we get 200 routers in the last part.

mcqs.question: Which of the following is a disadvantage of the hierarchical routing?
mcqs.explanation: Hierarchical routing is simple but it is not optimum. In order to achieve optimum route, every router must be aware of all the routers in the network, it is not possible in hierarchical routing.

mcqs.question: Which of the following statement is incorrect in case of hierarchical routing?
mcqs.explanation: Hierarchical routing does not provide optimum paths for the packet transmission, because every router is not aware of the routes other that the core routers. And, each region may use different local routing algorithms which makes routing non-optimal.

mcqs.question: Fair channel allocation is provided by the network in hierarchical routing.
mcqs.explanation: A large network is divided into levels which facilitates the devices with good channel allocation. As the number of devices decreases for each part(region), the network communication will be easy in regions.

links.context:
This set of Computer Networks Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Switches and Hubs”.

Technical Primer for this Topic: Network Devices Overview

mcqs.question: Which of the following is not concerned by the switch to manage traffic in it?
mcqs.explanation: Number of ports don’t affect the traffic because each port will have its own collision domain to provide descent traffic. MAC address is used to send the packets to destination ports to avoid collision.

mcqs.question: Which type of switch has more features among the following?
mcqs.explanation: Enterprise managed switch has advanced features like SNMP age, web interface and CLI prompt. Unlike unmanaged switches, it can modify the changes, display, restore and backup the configuration.

mcqs.question: Which of the following can’t be a feature of hub?
mcqs.explanation: Main disadvantage of the hub is, it broadcasts every message without filtering the address in it. As the hub has no intelligence, it sends packets to every port. Also, bandwidth will be wasted for the ports, which are not interested in receiving the packet.

mcqs.question: Which of the following are the types present in the hubs?
mcqs.explanation: Passive hubs are used in physical networks, where each device is connected to it physically. Active hubs keep an eye on packets that are being transmitted using store technology. Intelligent hubs have more features such as problem resolving, good performance.

mcqs.question: Which of the following is incorrect about hubs?

options.a: a) It does not have intelligence
options.d: d) It has no IP address

mcqs.explanation: A switch has no intelligence, and it does not need information about the routes as it uses broadcast messages. Regardless of routes are routing tables and broadcast messages will be sent to each port.

mcqs.question: What is the form of data, that is transmitted in the hub?
mcqs.explanation: Physical layer takes care of the electrical signal, which needs to be passed through different media. Bits are sent as electrical signal and can be converted into light pulses also.

mcqs.question: Which of the following device belongs to physical layer?
mcqs.explanation: Hub and repeater are the physical layer devices which does not concern data link layer addresses in any way to transmit the frames. A hub has multiple lines to connect devices and sends frames that arrive on one line to every line regardless of destination.

mcqs.question: Which of the following device is a data link layer device?
mcqs.explanation: Switches are also called as modern bridges and uses the frame headers to transmit the frames to the destination computer.

mcqs.question: What is the maximum speed of the hub for packet broadcasting?
mcqs.explanation: A normal hub can transmit at speed of 10 MBPS only. As the layer 2 device doesn’t, it has less transmission speed than upper layers.

mcqs.question: A hub has full duplex mode of transmission.
mcqs.explanation: A hub has half-duplex in which sender and receiver can transmit the data but not at the same time. This is because, hub has only one collision domain, so it is not possible for any two hosts to send the data at a time causing collision.

links.context: This set of Computer Networks Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Datagram Networks”.

mcqs.question: Datagram switching is done at which layer of OSI model?
mcqs.explanation: Datagram switching is normally done at network layer. In datagram switching, the datagram stream need not be in order as each datagram can take different routes to the destination.

mcqs.question: Packets in datagram switching are referred to as ________
mcqs.explanation: As the name suggests, in datagram switching packets are called as datagram. Each datagram/packet is treated as an individual entity and routed independently through the network.

mcqs.question: Datagram networks mainly refers to _________
mcqs.explanation: The switch does not keep the information about the connection state, hence it is connection less. There is no need for establishing a handshake to begin the transmission in such networks.

mcqs.question: Datagrams are routed to their destinations with the help of ________
mcqs.explanation: Routing table is used to route the packets to their destinations. The packet/datagram header contains the destination header for the whole journey to source to the destination through the routers.

mcqs.question: The main contents of the routing table in datagram networks are ___________

options.b: b) Destination address and Output port
options.c: c) Source address and Output port
options.d: d) Input port and Output port

mcqs.answer: b) Destination address and Output port
mcqs.explanation: Routing table contains destination address and output port to route the packets to their destinations. The port address specifies the particular application that the packet has to be forwarded to after it has reached the destination.

mcqs.question: Which of the following remains same in the header of the packet in a datagram network during the entire journey of the packet?
mcqs.explanation: Destination address remains same in the header during the entire journey of the packet. There is no pre-decided route for the packets so each datagram/packet is treated as an individual entity and routed independently through the network.

mcqs.question: Which of the following is true with respect to the delay in datagram networks?

options.a: a) Delay is greater than in a virtual circuit network
options.b: b) Each packet may experience a wait at a switch
options.c: c) Delay is not uniform for the packets of a message

mcqs.explanation: The delay of each packet in a datagram network is different as each packet might take a different route to the destination. The delay includes the propagation delay and the processing delay that is induced at each stop/switch that the packet encounters in its journey.

mcqs.question: During datagram switching, the packets are placed in __________ to wait until the given transmission line becomes available.
mcqs.explanation: When there are too many packets to be transmitted and the transmission line gets blocked while transmitting some packets, the remaining packets are stored in queue during delay and are served as first in first out. The delay is called as queuing delay.

mcqs.question: The probability of the error in a transmitted block _________ with the length of the block
mcqs.explanation: Probability of the error in a transmitted block increases with the length of the block. Hence, the blocks should be as short as possible for ideal transmission with low possibility of an error.

mcqs.question: Which of the following is false with respect to the datagram networks?

options.a: a) Number of flows of packets are not limited
options.b: b) Packets may not be in order at the destination
options.d: d) Delay is the same for all packets in a flow

mcqs.answer: d) Delay is the same for all packets in a flow
mcqs.explanation: The delay of each packet in a datagram network is different as each packet might take a different route to the destination. This happens because there is no pre-decided route for the packets.

links.context:
This set of Computer Networks Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Firewalls”.

Prep Material for this Topic: Firewall in Computer Networks

mcqs.question: Network layer firewall works as a __________
mcqs.explanation: As you know, firewalls are available as hardware appliances, as software-only, or a combination of the two. In every case, the purpose of a firewall is to isolate your trusted internal network (or your personal PC) from the dangers of unknown resources on the Internet and other network connections that may be harmful. The firewall prevents unauthorized access to your internal, trusted network from outside threats.

mcqs.question: Network layer firewall has two sub-categories as _________

options.a: a) State full firewall and stateless firewall
options.b: b) Bit oriented firewall and byte oriented firewall
options.c: c) Frame firewall and packet firewall
options.d: d) Network layer firewall and session layer firewall

mcqs.answer: a) State full firewall and stateless firewall
mcqs.explanation: Most network layer firewalls can operate as stateful or stateless firewalls, creating two subcategories of the standard network layer firewall. Stateful firewalls have the advantage of being able to track packets over a period of time for greater analysis and accuracy — but they require more memory and operate more slowly. Stateless firewalls do not analyze past traffic and can be useful for systems where speed is more important than security, or for systems that have very specific and limited needs. For example, a computer that only needs to connect to a particular backup server does not need the extra security of a stateful firewall.

mcqs.question: A firewall is installed at the point where the secure internal network and untrusted external network meet which is also known as __________
mcqs.explanation: A firewall can be a PC, a router, a midrange, a mainframe, a UNIX workstation, or a combination of these that determines which information or services can be accessed from the outside and who is permitted to use the information and services from outside. Generally, a firewall is installed at the point where the secure internal network and untrusted external network meet, which is also known as a chokepoint.

mcqs.question: Which of the following is / are the types of firewall?
mcqs.explanation: A firewall can be a PC, a midrange, a mainframe, a UNIX workstation, a router, or combination of these. Depending on the requirements, a firewall can consist of one or more of the following functional components: Packet-filtering router

mcqs.question: A proxy firewall filters at _________
mcqs.explanation: The application firewall is typically built to control all network traffic on any layer up to the application layer. It is able to control applications or services specifically, unlike a stateful network firewall, which is – without additional software – unable to control network traffic regarding a specific application. There are two primary categories of application firewalls, network-based application firewalls and host-based application firewalls.

mcqs.question: A packet filter firewall filters at __________

options.c: c) Network layer or Transport layer

mcqs.answer: c) Network layer or Transport layer
mcqs.explanation: In computing, a firewall is a network security system that monitors and controls the incoming and outgoing network traffic based on predetermined security rules.[1] A firewall typically establishes a barrier between a trusted, secure internal network and another outside network, such as the Internet, that is assumed not to be secure or trusted.[2] Firewalls are often categorized as either network firewalls or host-based firewalls.

mcqs.question: What is one advantage of setting up a DMZ with two firewalls?

options.a: a) You can control where traffic goes in three networks
options.b: b) You can do stateful packet filtering
options.c: c) You can do load balancing

mcqs.answer: c) You can do load balancing
mcqs.explanation: DMZ stands for De-Militarized Zone. In a topology with a single firewall serving both internal and external users (LAN and WAN), it acts as a shared resource for these two zones. So load balancing can be done by adding another firewall.

mcqs.question: What tells a firewall how to reassemble a data stream that has been divided into packets?

options.b: b) The number in the header’s identification field
options.d: d) The header checksum field in the packet header

mcqs.explanation: The source routing feature provides a path address for the packet to help the firewall to reassemble the data stream that was divided into packets. After reassembling, the firewall can then filter the stream.

mcqs.question: A stateful firewall maintains a ___________ which is a list of active connections.
mcqs.explanation: The routing table basically gives the state of each connection i.e. whether the connection is active or not. A routing table ensures the best performance for the stateful firewall.

mcqs.question: A firewall needs to be __________ so that it can grow proportionally with the network that it protects.
mcqs.explanation: The firewall has to be scalable because a network is expected to grow with time and if the firewall is unable to grow with it, the firewall won’t be able to handle the growing network traffic flow and will hence fail.

links.context: This set of Computer Networks Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Network Management”.

mcqs.question: Complex networks today are made up of hundreds and sometimes thousands of _________
mcqs.explanation: Complex networks today are made up of hundreds and sometimes thousands of components. For effective functioning of these thousands of components, good network management is essential.

mcqs.question: Performance management is closely related to _________
mcqs.explanation: Fault management is really closely related to performance management. It is important to ensure that the network handles faults as effectively as it handles it’s normal functioning to achieve better performance management.

mcqs.question: Configuration management can be divided into two subsystems: reconfiguration and __________
mcqs.explanation: The documentation subsystem of configuration management handles the log making and reporting functions of the configuration management. It also reports the errors in the network caused by the configuration’s failure.

mcqs.question: In Network Management System, the term that is responsible for controlling access to network based on predefined policy is called ___________
mcqs.explanation: In Network Management System, the term that is responsible for controlling access to the network based on predefined policy is called security management. The security management ensures authentication, confidentiality and integrity in the network.
