mcqs.explanation: IDSes work in a manner similar to modern antivirus technology. They are constantly updated with attack-definition files (signatures) that describe each type of known malicious activity. Nemean is a popular signature generation method for conventional computer networks.

mcqs.question: “Semantics-aware” signatures automatically generated by Nemean are based on traffic at which two layers?

options.a: a) Application layer and Transport layer
options.b: b) Network layer and Application layer
options.c: c) Session layer and Transport layer
options.d: d) Application layer and Session layer

mcqs.answer: d) Application layer and Session layer
mcqs.explanation: Nemean automatically generates “semantics-aware” signatures based on traffic at the session and application layers. These signatures are used to ensure that no malicious operation is contained in the traffic.

mcqs.question: Which of the following is used to provide a baseline measure for comparison of IDSes?
mcqs.explanation: As the sensitivity of systems may cause the false positive/negative rates to vary, it’s critical to have some common measure that may be applied across the board.

mcqs.question: Which of the following is true of signature-based IDSes?

options.a: a) They alert administrators to deviations from “normal” traffic behavior
options.b: b) They identify previously unknown attacks
options.c: c) The technology is mature and reliable enough to use on production networks
options.d: d) They scan network traffic or packets to identify matches with attack-definition files

mcqs.answer: d) They scan network traffic or packets to identify matches with attack-definition files
mcqs.explanation: They are constantly updated with attack-definition files (signatures) that describe each type of known malicious activity. They then scan network traffic for packets that match the signatures, and then raise alerts to security administrators.

links.context: This set of Computer Networks Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Cisco Lan Switches”.

mcqs.question: ___________ command is used to enter privileged mode in a switch.
mcqs.explanation: “enable” command is used to enter a privileged mode in a switch. The privileged mode allows verification, reloading and erasing of the configuration. “configure terminal” is used to enter the global configuration mode, “hostname” is used to change the device name and “wr” is used to save the running configuration.

mcqs.question: Which command is used to configure telnet for remote access?
mcqs.explanation: “line vty 0 4” is used to configure telnet for remote access, “0 4” specifies the number of simultaneous users in this case 5. “login” command is used to specify when the password is to be asked, “enable” is used to access privileged mode and “interface fastEthernet 0/1” is used to access the interface for ethernet port 0/1.

mcqs.question: How to create a VLAN in a switch?
mcqs.explanation: “vlan” is the command used to create a VLAN. “name HR” is used to assign a name to a VLAN, “interface vlan” is used to access the interface of a VLAN and “no vlan” command is used to delete a VLAN.

mcqs.question: Which command is used to check whether the trunking is configured or not?
mcqs.explanation: “show interface trunk” is used to check whether the trunking is configured or not and on which port it is configured. “switchport mode trunk” and “switchport mode access” is to configure trunk and access mode on a switch port, respectively. “show running configuration” is used to check the current running configuration of a switch.

mcqs.question: Switch CLI is used to configure routing protocols.
mcqs.explanation: Router CLI is used to configure routing protocols. Switch CLI is only used for management purposes and to configure VLANs and ssh.

mcqs.question: How to enable different ports to access a VLAN?
mcqs.explanation: “switchport access vlan” is used to give different ports access to a VLAN. “switchport mode trunk” and “switchport mode access” is to configure trunk and access mode on a switch port, respectively. “interface vlan” is used to access the interface of a VLAN.

mcqs.question: Which command is used to change the interface status of a port or VLAN?
mcqs.explanation: “no shutdown” command is used to change the interface status of a port or VLAN to active or “UP”. “no auto-summary” is a command used to prevent classful summary of IP addresses, “interface fastEthernet 0/1” is used to access the interface for ethernet port 0/1 and “copy run start” is used to copy the running configuration over the start-up configuration.

mcqs.question: The switch requires an IP address for each port in use.
mcqs.explanation: No, it is not required for each port in use to have an IP address. An IP address is assigned only for management, which is otherwise not required.

mcqs.question: Which command is used to reboot a switch?
mcqs.explanation: “reload” command is used to reboot a switch. “exit” command is used to exit a interface, “shutdown” command is used to change the interface status of a port or VLAN to “DOWN”, and “copy run start” is used to copy the running configuration over the start-up configuration.

links.context: This set of Basic Computer Networks Questions and Answers focuses on “PPP”.

mcqs.question: Both HDLC and PPP are Data link layer protocols.
mcqs.explanation: Both HDLC and PPP both are Data link layer protocol. HDLC stands for High level Data Link Control and PPP stands for Point to Point Protocol.

mcqs.question: Which protocol does the PPP protocol provide for handling the capabilities of the connection/link on the network?
mcqs.explanation: LCP stands for Link Control Protocol and NCP stands for Network Control Protocol. LCP and NCP are the PPP protocols which provide interface for handling the capabilities of the connection/link on the network.

mcqs.question: The PPP protocol _________

options.a: a) Is designed for simple links which transport packets between two peers
options.b: b) Is one of the protocols for making an Internet connection over a phone line
options.c: c) Is designed for simple links which transport packets between two peers and making an Internet connection over a phone line
options.d: d) Is used for sharing bandwidth

mcqs.answer: c) Is designed for simple links which transport packets between two peers and making an Internet connection over a phone line
mcqs.explanation: The PPP protocol is designed for handling simple links which transport packets between two peers. It is a standard protocol that is used to make an Internet connection over phone lines.

mcqs.question: PPP provides the _______ layer in the TCP/IP suite.
mcqs.explanation: PPP provides function of the link layer in the TCP/IP suite. It focuses on the link between two nodes that is going to be used by the users to communicate. It can use pre-installed phone line for the purpose.

mcqs.question: PPP consists of ________components

options.a: a) Three (encapsulating, the Domain Name system)
options.b: b) Three (encapsulating, a link control protocol, NCP)
options.c: c) Two (a link control protocol, Simple Network Control protocol)

mcqs.answer: b) Three (encapsulating, a link control protocol, NCP)
mcqs.explanation: PPP consists of three components namely Link Control Protocol (LCP), Network Control Protocol (NCP), and Encapsulation. LCP and NCP are the PPP protocols which provide interface for handling the capabilities of the connection/link on the network and encapsulation provides for multiplexing of different network-layer protocols.

mcqs.question: The PPP encapsulation ____________

options.a: a) Provides for multiplexing of different network-layer protocols
options.b: b) Requires framing to indicate the beginning and end of the encapsulation
options.c: c) Establishing, configuring and testing the data-link connection
options.d: d) Provides interface for handling the capabilities of the connection/link on the network

mcqs.answer: a) Provides for multiplexing of different network-layer protocols
mcqs.explanation: Encapsulation is a part of PPP which provides means for multiplexing of different network-layer protocols. The other two parts of PPP are Link Control Protocol and Network Control Protocol.

mcqs.question: A Link Control Protocol (LCP) is used for ____________

options.a: a) Establishing, configuring and testing the data-link connection
options.b: b) Establishing and configuring different network-layer protocols
options.c: c) Testing the different network-layer protocols
options.d: d) Provides for multiplexing of different network-layer protocols

mcqs.answer: a) Establishing, configuring and testing the data-link connection
mcqs.explanation: The Link Control Protocol (LCP) is the part of PPP that is used for establishing, configuring and testing the data-link connection. The other two components are Network Control Protocol and Encapsulation.

mcqs.question: A family of network control protocols (NCPs) ____________

options.a: a) Are a series of independently defined protocols that provide a dynamic
options.b: b) Are a series of independently-defined protocols that encapsulate
options.c: c) Are a series of independently defined protocols that provide transparent

mcqs.answer: b) Are a series of independently-defined protocols that encapsulate
mcqs.explanation: The family of network control protocols (NCPs) is a series of independently-defined protocols that encapsulate the data flowing between the two nodes. It provides means for the network nodes to control the link traffic.

mcqs.question: Choose the correct statement from the following.

options.a: a) PPP can terminate the link at any time
options.b: b) PPP can terminate the link only during the link establishment phase
options.c: c) PPP can terminate the link during the authentication phase
options.d: d) PPP can terminate the link during the callback control phase

mcqs.answer: a) PPP can terminate the link at any time
mcqs.explanation: PPP allows termination of the link at any time in any phase because it works on the data link layer which is the layer in control of the link of the communication.

mcqs.question: The link necessarily begins and ends with this phase. During the ______ phase, the LCP automata will be in INITIAL or STARTING states.
mcqs.explanation: The link necessarily begins and ends with the link dead phase. During this phase, the LCP automata will be in the initial or its final state. The link is non-functioning or inactive during the link dead phase.

links.context: This set of Computer Networks Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “EIGRP”.

mcqs.question: EIGRP is a routing protocol design by Cisco.
mcqs.explanation: EIGRP stands for Enhanced Interior Gateway Routing Protocol is a routing protocol designed by Cisco. It is available only on Cisco routers.

mcqs.question: EIGRP metric is ________
mcqs.explanation: EIGRP metric is K-values which are integers from 0 to 128. They are used to calculate the overall EIGRP cost with bandwidth and delay metrics.

mcqs.question: EIGRP can support ____________
mcqs.explanation: EIGRP supports variable and fixed length subnetting, Auto summary, and Unequal cast load balancing to provide efficient routing functionality on Cisco routers.

mcqs.question: EIGRP sends a hello message after every ___________ seconds.
mcqs.explanation: EIGRP routers broadcast the hello packets frequently to familiarize with the neighbors. EIGRP routers send the hello message after every 5 seconds on LAN, and every 60 seconds on WAN.

mcqs.question: Administrative distance for internal EIGRP is ______
mcqs.explanation: Routers use the metric of administrative distance to select the best path when there are different routes to the same destination from two different routing protocols as it is a measure of reliability of routing protocols. Administrative distance for internal EIGRP is 90.

mcqs.question: The EIGRP metric values include:
mcqs.explanation: The EIGRP metric values are Delay, Bandwidth, and MTU. MTU stands for Maximum Transmission Unit. They are combined together to give the overall EIGRP cost in K-values.

mcqs.question: For default gateway, which of following commands will you use on a Cisco router?
mcqs.explanation: IP default network command is used to find the default gateway in Cisco router. If the router finds routes to the node, it considers the routes to that node for installation as the gateway to it.

mcqs.question: Administrative distance for external EIGRP route is _______
mcqs.explanation: Routers use the metric of administrative distance to select the best path when there are different routes to the same destination from two different routing protocols as it is a measure of reliability of routing protocols. Administrative distance for external EIGRP is 170.

mcqs.question: EIGRP uses the ____________ algorithm for finding shortest path.
mcqs.explanation: EIGRP uses the DUAL algorithm for finding shortest path. DUAL stands for diffusing update algorithm and it is used to prevent routing loops by recalculating routes globally.

mcqs.question: In EIGRP best path is known as the successor, where as backup path is known as __________

options.d: d) There is no backup route in EIGRP

mcqs.explanation: Feasible successor is the backup path. The backup path is used alternatively used whenever the best path fails. It is not used primarily because it is comparatively expensive than the best path.

title: 12. MCQ on Review of Information Network and Technology

links.context: This set of Computer Network Management Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Local Area Networks”.

mcqs.question: Traditional LANs run at the speeds of _____________
mcqs.explanation: LAN is a configuration that supports personal computers. It is highly reliable for a limited geographical area. The speed of LAN is limited from 10 to 100 Mbps. This is enough to satisfy the high volume demand.

mcqs.question: A local area network is generally a public owned communications network within a limitless geographical area.
mcqs.explanation: A local area network (LAN) is a private network. It is limited to a specific area. WAN on the other hand is used for extremely large geographical areas.

mcqs.question: The transmission channels in LAN generally use __________ cables.
mcqs.explanation: There are several types of cables used in LAN. The most commonly used cables for transmission channels in LAN are UTP (Unshielded Twisted Pair) due to their low cost and ease of installation.

mcqs.question: _______ standard is used by Wireless LAN.
mcqs.explanation: IEEE 802.11 specifies the set of protocols for implementing Wireless LAN (WLAN). IEEE 802.3 standard is for bus networks. IEEE 802.3 standard defines the MAC layer and Physical layer of the Ethernet. Hence it forms the foundation for the specification of Ethernet protocol. IEEE 802.2 standard is used for specifying logical link control above the Data Link Layer of the OSI model. IEEE 802.5 standard is used for Token-ring topology.

mcqs.question: _________ is a Wireless LAN technology.
mcqs.explanation: Bluetooth is one example of Wireless LAN technology that is used for exchanging data over short distances. It also provides secure wireless communications. PSTN, Cable Television and Internet Access are wired technologies.

mcqs.question: Data Link technology for Local Area Networks (LAN) is _________
mcqs.explanation: Token Ring Technology gives specifications for communication protocols in LANs. This technology is more deterministic than Ethernet. It uses Ring topology. This is the only option referring to a technology whereas Hybrid, Fully Connected and Mesh refers to Network topologies.

mcqs.question: 100BaseT4 networks are wired together using ____________
mcqs.explanation: 100BaseT4 is one of the three types of Ethernet cable. These physical wiring can carry up to 100 Mbps. 100BaseT4 networks uses Star topology for its connections.

mcqs.question: Collision detection in LAN can be achieved by CSMA/CA.
mcqs.explanation: Collision detection is a process that helps in detecting the collision/interference of two data packets in a network. Thus CSMA/CD (Carrier Sense Multiple Access/Collision Detection) is method used for the same in LANs. Whereas CSMA/CA (Carrier Sense Multiple Access/Collision Avoidance) is used for avoiding or preventing those collisions.

mcqs.question: __________ is a type of LAN data transmission.
mcqs.explanation: Data transmission in LAN comes under three types. Those are unicast, multicast, and broadcast. The data packets are sent in the form of a network frame to a node and further it is transmitted on the basis of topology.

mcqs.question: A repeater is a _________ layer device.
mcqs.explanation: In an extended network repeaters are used to connect media elements. These repeaters operate on the physical layer of the OSI model. It removes noise from a signal.

mcqs.question: In a Broadcast transmission __________

options.a: a) a packet is transmitted from a source to many destinations on the network
options.b: b) a single packet is transmitted from a source to a destination on the network
options.c: c) a packet is transmitted from many sources to one destination on the network
options.d: d) a single packet is copied and sent to all nodes on the network

mcqs.answer: d) a single packet is copied and sent to all nodes on the network
mcqs.explanation: In LANs the data transmission methods are classified into three types. Those are unicast, multicast, and broadcast. In unicast, a frame is sent from one node to another on a network. In broadcast, a frame or data packet is transmitted from one node to all other nodes on the network. Lastly, in a multicast, the frames are carried in a network to many receivers at the same time.

mcqs.question: ___________ device is used for connecting LAN.
mcqs.explanation: Bridges are also known as LAN Switches. Bridges are used for connecting two or more LANs. It also helps in forwarding the data packets to these networks.

mcqs.question: The networks that needs central monitoring, still uses __________
mcqs.explanation: There are three significant types of Terminals used by LAN. Those are smart terminal, intelligent terminal and dumb terminal. The dumb terminal does not carry out the function of data processing. In central monitoring systems we need terminals that will just carry out the tasks of sending and receiving data packets. Thus dumb terminal is used in such networks.

mcqs.question: Collisions are improbable in _________ networks.
mcqs.explanation: Token passing is a channel access method used in Local Area Networks (LANs). It helps in preventing collision in the network. This method uses Ring topology.

mcqs.question: The diagram below represents ___________ type of data transmission in LAN.
mcqs.explanation: The given diagram is that of a broadcast data transmission. There are three different types of data transmission in LAN and those are unicast, multicast, and broadcast. In broadcast, packet is send to all the nodes.

links.context: This set of Computer Network Management Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Network Node Components”.

mcqs.question: ___________ is one of the resource for network node.
mcqs.explanation: Resources used for network nodes are hubs, switches, bridges, routers and gateways or a combination of the above such as a brouter and hub.

mcqs.question: ____________ is considered as a network node and also network security.
mcqs.explanation: Firewall is an entity that is a network security component but it is also considered as a network node. Malware and Ransomware are generally cyber security threats and do not qualify under network security components. Mobile secure gateway on the other is a defense method against cyber threats and is not a network node.

mcqs.question: At the Data Link layer, Bridge acts as an intelligent __________ switch.
mcqs.explanation: When a group of data is transmitted from a source to its destination in the form of packets then that process is termed as packet switching. Bridges are one such network node which uses packet switching as their transmission method. They are used for connecting LANs.

mcqs.question: Router works at the transport layer of OSI Model.
mcqs.explanation: This given statement is false. Router is a network node component that operates on Network Layer. It helps in sending the data packets to the destination network. It provides appropriate direction to the data packets in network.

mcqs.question: The routing algorithm used by transparent bridge is __________ algorithm.
mcqs.explanation: Transparent bridges maintain a routing table. This table comprises of MAC (Media Access Control) addresses. It connects two LANs. It acts transparent to other networks thus the name Transparent bridge is justified. It maintains the information regarding traffic in a particular network. Transparent Bridges are used generally in Ethernet. Thus Spanning-tree algorithm is used in transparent bridge.

mcqs.question: In a LAN configuration, hubs can be seen as a DTE (Data Terminal Equipment) that are connected using _______
mcqs.explanation: Considering the features of network components, Hubs and Repeaters are similar to certain extent. Hubs act as multiport repeaters. Repeaters help in regeneration of data signal flowing through a network when it enters a new network. Thus it is incorporated in LANs for connecting hubs.

mcqs.question: In bridged networks _________ algorithm is used for bridging token-ring LANs.
mcqs.explanation: In Source-routing algorithm, the source or the sender is allowed to specify the path or address of the destination. It also dynamically filters traffic, protocols and interfaces. It is used for bridging token-ring segments.

mcqs.question: The transparent bridge learns routing information by a ______ learning process.
mcqs.explanation: A transparent bridge is also known as adaptive bridge. It uses backward learning process to gain routing information. It keeps information about all the nodes connected to specific ports.

mcqs.question: Source Routing Bridge is more reliable as compared to Transparent Bridge.
mcqs.explanation: The Source Routing Bridge is faster and that makes it less reliable. The Transparent Bridge on the other hand proves to be more robust and reliable. Source routing bridge is a heavy resource consuming network component.

mcqs.question: Which protocol is used by the router to determine the port associated with the destination address?
mcqs.explanation: Address Resolution Protocol (ARP) is applied on the Network Layer. A router also operates in the same layer. Thus a router uses ARP for its applications. It is used for mapping MAC address with IP address.

mcqs.question: A ___________ combines two autonomous networks.
mcqs.explanation: In an autonomous network, it is very important for the data to flow from one discrete network to the other and to convey the same meaning at every network. Thus, gateway is a network node component that helps in translating one protocol to the other and connects two completely independent networks.

mcqs.question: __________ is an alternative to the use of gateway to communicate between autonomous networks, using multiprotocol router.
mcqs.explanation: Tunneling is a process used when the source and the destination are on the same network. Though different protocols are to be applied while data traverses through dissimilar networks, protocol conversion is not implemented here. Instead, the data frames are encapsulated and transmitted through the networks.

mcqs.question: __________ is a routing technique deployed in the Edge Routers.
mcqs.explanation: The name edge router arises from the fact that edge routers generally operates on the edge of a network. MPLS is a routing technique that is used by Edge routers and these routers are termed as MPLS Edge routers. Whereas Fixed weighted, Round Robin and Adaptive balancing are load balancing techniques and not routing techniques.

links.context: This set of Computer Network Management Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Wide Area Networks”.

mcqs.question: _________ is a communication system that spans through a large area.
mcqs.explanation: Internet communication is an example of WAN technology. Wide Area Network (WAN), as the name suggests is used for covering large areas in a network such as a state, country, etc. MANs are used to cover the network of the Metropolitan regions. LANs cover a limited area. PAN is used for individual network purposes.

mcqs.question: WAN can be partitioned into two sections from network management perspective. Those are _________ and transmissions between switching offices.
mcqs.explanation: We can partition WAN from a network management perspective into two sections and analyze the components and services that need to be managed in each. WAN is used for extremely large geographical areas. The two end sections of WAN are the subscriber loop sections, where information flows from central offices of the service provider lo customer’s premises. The other section is transmission between switching offices.

mcqs.question: In Subscriber loop section _____________ forms a part of active links.
mcqs.explanation: A WAN is partitioned into two sections based on network management grounds. Subscriber loop Section is one of the two partitions. This section is further classified as passive links and active links. A dedicated wire from central office to customer premises is a part of passive links and coaxial cable is a part of an active link.

mcqs.question: __________ is an example of Wide Area Network (WAN).
mcqs.explanation: Wide Area Networks (WAN) covers networks of large geographical areas. Since the internet is a phenomenon that is used throughout the world. Thus Internet access is an application of WAN. Whereas home router, cell networks, and cable TV networks are applications of LAN, PAN and MAN respectively.

mcqs.question: Wide Area Networks provide low speed connectivity to its users.
mcqs.explanation: WAN networks provide a high speed connectivity making it a more reliable network for the customers. Internet is an example of WAN that requires high speed connectivity for its smooth operation.

mcqs.question: _________ are used for connecting Hosts in Wide Area Network (WAN) to each other.
mcqs.explanation: A subnet is a smaller group of networks that were fragmented from IP network. These subnets are used for connection of hosts in WAN.

mcqs.question: In satellite WAN ___________ protocol is used.
mcqs.explanation: CDMA is used in 2G and 3G mobile technologies. CDMA is a channel access method where several transmitters can send their data simultaneously on a single channel. Thus this protocol is used in Satellite WAN.

mcqs.question: An asynchronous connection uses __________ encapsulation.
mcqs.explanation: In WAN technology, an asynchronous serial connection is configured using Point to Point Protocol (PPP) and Asynchronous Transfer Mode (ATM) encapsulation methods.

mcqs.question: The WAN operates at Network layer and Physical layer of the OSI model.
mcqs.explanation: WAN is a type of network that covers large geographical areas. It operates at the Physical layer and Data link layer of the standard OSI model.

mcqs.question: _________ WAN technology requires more bandwidth for transferring voice, video and data.
mcqs.explanation: Asynchronous Transfer Mode is a WAN technology that uses a switching method for its operation. It is connection oriented and thus requires large bandwidth for VoIP transmissions.

links.context: This set of Computer Network Management Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Wired/Wireless Transmission Media”.

mcqs.question: Narrow-band LAN technology uses _________ mode of transmission.
mcqs.explanation: Narrow-band LAN technologies are implemented in Telecommunication systems. It is used for carrying voice data on a very limited set of frequencies. Narrow-band uses digital mode of transmission and also is based on Simplex mode that implies, it communicates only in one direction.

mcqs.question: In a twisted-pair cable, the gauge of the wire and the type of twist determines the _________
mcqs.explanation: Twisted-pair cables are mostly applicable in Telephone Systems. The quality of twisted-pair cable decreases with increase in length. Also, the attenuation decreases as the length increases. Thus the gauge of the wire and the type of twist is important in determining the quality of transmission of a twisted-pair cable.

mcqs.question: The method for taking advantage of optical wavelength of transmission, in order to increase capacity of information in an optical transmission medium is known as __________
mcqs.explanation: Wavelength Division Multiplexing (WDM) is a multiplexing technique that combines a number of optical signals into a single optical fiber. It combines wavelength of these different optical carrier signals and helps in increasing the capacity of optical fibers by decreasing the transmission loss.

mcqs.question: For an IP based protocol, the MPLS label is inserted between which two headers?

options.a: a) IEEE 802.3 MAC header and Network layer IP header
options.b: b) IEEE 802.11 MAC header and Transport layer MAC header
options.c: c) Transport layer IP header and Network layer IP header
options.d: d) Physical layer MAC header and Data Link layer IP header

mcqs.answer: a) IEEE 802.3 MAC header and Network layer IP header
mcqs.explanation: MPLS (Multiprotocol Label Switching) label is highly scalable. It operates at the interface between network layer and link layer of the OSI model. Therefore, in an IP based protocol, MPLS label is positioned between IEEE 802.3 MAC header and Network layer IP header.

mcqs.question: Which of the following uses Bluetooth as a Wireless technology?
mcqs.explanation: Bluetooth is an example of Wireless technology that is used for exchanging data over short distances. It also provides secure wireless communication. Thus, such a secure and short ranged technology is used Personal Area Networks.

mcqs.question: What is a Scatternet?

options.a: a) It is a group of interconnected Micronets
options.b: b) It is a group of interconnected Mininets
options.c: c) It is a group of interconnected Intranets
options.d: d) It is a group of interconnected Piconets

mcqs.answer: d) It is a group of interconnected Piconets
mcqs.explanation: Scatternet is a network connecting two or more Piconets having Bluetooth technology incorporated in their network devices. It supports communication between more than 8 devices. Thus, Scatternet can also be defined as interconnected Piconets.

mcqs.question: Personal Communication Services (PCS) and Digital Cellular Services are based on cell based technology.
mcqs.explanation: Personal Communication Services (PCS) and Digital Cellular Services are the two advanced segments of wireless technology. These segments are important for data communication. Thus they are based on cellular technology and rely on multiple access principle.

mcqs.question: __________ uses all its energy in gathering data signals at one particular direction.
mcqs.explanation: Directional Antenna helps in increasing the gain of a signal in forward direction or one particular direction. It is also known as beam antenna. It avoids interference of unwanted signals.

mcqs.question: In wireless communications, how are collisions made oblivious to its users?

options.a: a) By hiding nodes in a network
options.b: b) By increasing the signal strength
options.c: c) By avoiding interference of unwanted signals
options.d: d) By exposing the terminals in a network

mcqs.answer: a) By hiding nodes in a network
mcqs.explanation: In wireless communications, there exists a hidden node problem. This occurs when a node or a station is visible to an Access Point but not to other stations communicating with the Access Point. The main reason behind this is that the stations are out of range of each other and thus collisions cannot be detected.

mcqs.question: Bluetooth communicates data using low-power radio waves that are within the frequencies ______ and _______
mcqs.explanation: The frequency band for Bluetooth communication is set by an international agreement. This frequency band is between 2.402 GHz and 2.480 GHz.

links.context: This set of Computer Network Management Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Integrated Services: ISDN and Broadband”.

mcqs.question: ISDN is the abbreviation for ___________ in computer networking.
mcqs.explanation: ISDN in computer networking stands for Integrated Services Digital Network. It enables the transmission of digital data over telephone lines. It is considered as a circuit-switched telephone network system.

mcqs.question: Integrated Services Digital Network (ISDN) can be classified into ____________ and _________ ISDN.
mcqs.explanation: Narrowband ISDN was implemented to make digital telephone systems more impactful over analog telephone systems. It utilizes narrow band of frequencies. Narrowband is also known as Normal-ISDN. Broadband ISDN on the other hand, is a standard for transmitting voice data on larger frequency bands.

mcqs.question: Basic Rate Interface (BRI) provides a better connection and is more reliable than the Primary Rate Interface (PRI).
mcqs.explanation: Basic Rate Interface (BRI) and Primary Rate Interface (PRI) are the two types of Integrated Services Digital Network (ISDN). The major difference between them is their reliability. BRI provides less reliability and low services at lower costs compared to PRI.

mcqs.question: _________ is ISDN’s connection control protocol.
mcqs.explanation: ISDN (Integrated Services Digital Network) is a connection oriented network system and uses Q.931 Protocol for managing its call states. Q.931 is a signaling protocol. It can be compared to SIP but SIP is not applicable to ISDN. SIP is a 3GPP signaling protocol. H.323 is a call signaling protocol that was initially implemented in LANs. ICMP is used in routers and helps in sending error messages.

mcqs.question: Integrated Services Digital Network (ISDN) is a ___________ interface between the subscriber and the central office.
mcqs.explanation: ISDN provides a set of standards for maintaining different call states. It is a circuit-switched telephone network system. It acts as an interface, and only a single device can be connected to this interface. This interface is based on full-duplex mode of data transmission.

mcqs.question: _________ is an Upper Layer Protocol that provides Flow Control.
mcqs.explanation: SMTP is an upper level protocol and it provides flow control. Whereas Frame relay Protocol operates in the layer such as Data Link Layer that is at lower levels of OSI model. Thus it doesn’t provide flow control or error control. Similarly other protocols such as TCP and ICMP operate in the lower levels of the OSI model.

mcqs.question: Which three areas have advanced due to significant contributions from Broadband Network and Services?

options.a: a) ATM, SONET/SDH, and broadband access technology
options.b: b) MPLS, Switching technology, and broadband technology
options.c: c) Frame Relay, ISDN and narrowband access technology
options.d: d) VPN, Firewall, and WAN technology

mcqs.answer: a) ATM, SONET/SDH, and broadband access technology
mcqs.explanation: Some network services require larger bandwidths that could not be achieved using Frame Relay. This has led to the implementation of broadband ISDN or also known as broadband network. Broadband network and service have contributed significantly in three areas. They are ATM (Asynchronous Transfer Mode), SONET (Synchronous Optical Network)/SDH (Synchronous Digital Hierarchy), and broadband access technology.

mcqs.question: X.25 Protocol can be carried over _________ channels of a Basic Rate Interface (BRI) Line.
mcqs.explanation: B channel is the Bearer channel where data and voice communication is carried; D is the Delta channel that carries control and signaling information; and H channel is the High-speed communication channel that is formed by combining multiple Bearer channels. Thus B or D channels of BRI line and B channels of PRI (Primary Rate Interface) line are used for carrying X.25.

title: 13. Basic Foundations: Standards, Models, and Language

links.context: This set of Computer Network Management Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Abstract Syntax Notation One (ASN.1)”.

mcqs.question: In Network Management System, ASN.1 stands for_______
mcqs.explanation: ASN.1 stands for Abstract Syntax Notation One. ASN.1 in computer networking is a standard used for defining data structures that are sent and received in a network.

mcqs.question: ASN.1 is a formal language developed jointly by _______ and _______ for use with application layers for data transfer between systems.
mcqs.explanation: ASN.1 is a standard language used for describing messages sent and received in a network. It is a joint standard developed by International Telecommunication Union (ITU-T) and International Organization for Standardization (ISO).

mcqs.question: How is Transfer Syntax different from Abstract Syntax?

options.a: a) It defines a set of rules used to define data types and structures for the storage of information
options.b: b) It represents the set of rules for communicating information between systems
options.c: c) It specifies the management protocol in the application layer
options.d: d) It makes ASN.1 independent of the lower-layer

mcqs.answer: b) It represents the set of rules for communicating information between systems
mcqs.explanation: The transfer syntax represents the set of rules for communicating information between systems. Whereas the Abstract Syntax is a set of rules used to specify data types and structures for the storage of information.

mcqs.question: Abstract Syntax Notation One (ASN.1) uses the grammar of Backus-Naur Form.
mcqs.explanation: ASN.1 is based on Backus system. It uses formal syntax language and grammar of Backus-Naur Form. Backus-Naur Form is a context-free grammar form.

mcqs.question: The symbol ‘::=’ stands for________  in ASN.1 language.
mcqs.explanation: ASN.1 uses several symbols and primitive data types including keywords. There is a list of symbols used but the symbol ‘::=’ here stands for ‘Assignment’.

mcqs.question: In Abstract Syntax Notation One, we can group assignments that are related to each other; is group is called _______
mcqs.explanation: ASN.1 is a standard language used for describing messages sent and received in a network. ASN.1 uses several symbols and primitive data types including keywords. Thus we can group similar assignments to form a Module.

mcqs.question: The universal tag  ‘ENUMERATED’ in ASN.1 defines ___________

options.b: b) a string of binary digits or null set
options.c: c) set of values associated with the object

mcqs.explanation: The universal class is the most commonly used class. Data types belonging to the universal class are application-independent. ENUMERATED is an example of universal class that is used to mean a specified list of Integers.

mcqs.question: Abstract syntax is applicable to communication model of OSI Network Management.
mcqs.explanation: The abstract syntax is defined the set of rules used to specify data types and structures for the storage of information. The abstract syntax is applicable to the information model whereas Transfer syntax is applicable to communication model.

mcqs.question: The terms_______, _______ and _____ are primitives and are called keywords in ASN.1
mcqs.explanation: The terms DEFINITIONS, BEGIN and END are primitives and are called keywords in ASN.1. They are built-in expressions and have special meaning. GET, GETNEXT, SET, GETBULK, GETREQUEST and TRAP are commands used in SNMP.

mcqs.question: _________ is the algorithm used to convert textual ASN.1 syntax to machine-readable code.
mcqs.explanation: The algorithm used to convert ASN.1 syntax to machine-readable code is defined in ISO 8825/X.209 standards. It is usually called Basic Encoding Rules (BER).

mcqs.question: ASN.1 does not enable rapid and reliable transmission of extensible messages compared to other notations.
mcqs.explanation: ASN.1 when compared to other notations, is more streamlined and reliable for transmission of messages. It provides efficient communication.

links.context: This set of Computer Network Management Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Functional Model”.

mcqs.question: _________ involves detection and isolation of the problem causing the failure in the network.
mcqs.explanation: Fault Management is a component of the Network Management Model. Apart from detecting and isolating problems in a telecommunication network, it also helps in the correction of those malfunctions.

mcqs.question: _______ is an application oriented traffic that can be analyzed using performance-monitoring tools.
mcqs.explanation: Performance-monitoring tools can gather statistics of all protocol layers. We can analyze the application-oriented traffic such as Web-traffic. The statistics on applications could be used to make policy decisions on managing the applications.

mcqs.question: In Network Management __________ plays a vital role in secure communication between two networks.
mcqs.explanation: Secured communication is concerned with the meddling of information as it traverses the network. The content of the information should neither be accessed nor altered by unauthorized third person. Cryptography plays a vital part in achieving this kind of security.

mcqs.question: Relevant management information is embedded in managed objects, such as switches, hubs, bridges, and routers.
mcqs.explanation: In Network Management Functional Model, the administration and maintenance of management information is looked after by configuration management. Thus each device in the network management system known as managed devices; possess some kind of management information. This setting up of parameters is involved in the configuration management.

mcqs.question: Service and Business Management is an another dimension of application management, directed towards _________
mcqs.explanation: Service and Business Management is an another dimension of application management. It is directed towards service providers. These service providers ensure customer satisfaction and profitability of business.

mcqs.question: __________ gathered by performance management serves as input to the process of accounting management.
mcqs.explanation: Accounting management looks after the cost allocation of the usage of the network whereas the performance behavior and the traffic of the network are managed by performance management. Traffic data gathered by performance management serves as input to this process.

mcqs.question: In Fault management system, what can be used to track network problems?
mcqs.explanation: Fault management involves the detection and isolation of the problem causing the failure in the network. A trouble ticket is generated and followed up for resolution of the problem using a trouble ticket administration system. Thus, a trouble ticket administration helps in tracking network problems.

mcqs.question: Accounting management administers the traffic and performance statistics on the network.
mcqs.explanation: There are five components of network management: Configuration Management, Fault Management, Performance Management, Security Management, and Accounting Management. Accounting management looks after the cost allocation of the usage of a network. The performance behavior and the traffic of the network are managed by performance management.

mcqs.question: What is Self-healing in network management?

options.a: a) It involves physically securing the network
options.b: b) It is isolation of network problems
options.c: c) It is reconfiguration of network
options.d: d) It involves monitoring the traffic of network system

mcqs.answer: b) It is isolation of network problems
mcqs.explanation: An NMS constantly monitors and displays in real-time major and minor alarms based on the severity of failures. Reconfiguration is a part of configuration management. In several failure situations, the network could do this automatically. This network feature is called self-healing.

mcqs.question: The two primary ways of performing Fault Management are __________ and __________
mcqs.explanation: Active and passive are the two ways of performing the tasks of detection and isolation of problems in network. Passive fault management helps in collecting alarms from network devices whereas Active Fault Management monitors the health of these devices.

links.context: This set of Computer Networks Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “SNMP”.

mcqs.question: The application-level protocol in which a few manager stations control a set of agents is called ______
mcqs.explanation: SNMP stands for Simple Network Management Protocol. It is an application-level protocol in which a few manager stations control a set of agents. It is used under the TCP/IP protocol suite and is used for managing devices on the internet.

mcqs.question: Full duplex mode increases the capacity of each domain by ________
mcqs.explanation: In full duplex mode, both endpoints share a single channel bandwidth to achieve two-way transmission. This results in complete utilization of the band capacity increasing the capacity by 10 to 20 mbps than half-duplex mode.

mcqs.question: Configuration management can be divided into which two subsystems?
mcqs.explanation: The best current practices report is created by a management group to ensure the most effective configuration management. The group also makes a MIB (Management Information Base) module to help with the configuration management.

mcqs.question: To use a Simple Network Management System, we need _______
mcqs.explanation: Rules are a collection of expression containing parameters to observe the attributes of the user’s device, and then execute some actions. It specifies the parameters for the managed objects inside the application and performs operations that would support the expression. The input of a rule may be many expressions or even a single expression that end in an output of single object invoking some action.

mcqs.question: The main difference between SNMPv3 and SNMPv2 is _______
mcqs.explanation: SNMPv3 has introduced new cryptographic security, through which confidentiality is provided by encrypting packets and blocking intruders. It also ensures that the message is coming from a reliable source.

mcqs.question: In Network Management System, the division that is responsible for controlling access to network based on a predefined policy is called _________
mcqs.explanation: Security management is also responsible to provide confidentiality, authentication and encryption in addition to controlling access to network. Without security management, the network and its traffic would be vulnerable to be exploited by attackers.

mcqs.question: BER stands for ________
mcqs.explanation: The Basic Encoding Rules are a set of rules that specify the guidelines to encode the SNMP messages in binary form. Each SNMP message is encoded into 3 parts namely data, length and type of message.

mcqs.question: Control of the users’ access to network resources through charges is the main responsibility of ________
mcqs.explanation: The accounting management keeps track of the users and their access rights to the network and controls the user’s access by communicating with the security management. The accounting management takes support of the Management Information Block to perform its operations.

mcqs.question: SNMP is the framework for managing devices in an internet using the ______
mcqs.explanation: SNMP is a management protocol in which a few manager stations control a set of agents using the TCP/IP protocol suite. SNMP stands for Simple Network Management Protocol.

mcqs.question: Structure of Management Information (SMI), is the guideline of ________
mcqs.explanation: SMI was developed by the Storage Networking Industry Association (SNIA) and it defines a standard that can be manipulated by SNMP. Basically, it defines the standard format and hierarchy of management data which is used by the SNMP. It does not describe how the objects are to be managed.

links.context: This set of Computer Network Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “SNMP Management”.

mcqs.question: _______ is a mechanism to transfer control messages between nodes.
mcqs.explanation: ICMP stands for Internet Control Message Protocol. ICMP is used for sending error and control messages to the various devices in a network.

mcqs.question: Simple Network Management Protocol (SNMP) uses _________ layer for carrying out its operation.
mcqs.explanation: SNMP is the most commonly used internet protocol. It operates on the application layer of the OSI reference model. It uses SNMP messages for monitoring and controlling network devices.

mcqs.question: SNMP Network Management System (NMSs) cannot manage non-TCP/IP network.
mcqs.explanation: SNMP is the most frequently used Network Management System. Most network components that are used in enterprise network systems have network agents built in them that can respond to an SNMP NMS. SNMP network management systems (NMSs) can manage even non-TCP/IP network elements through proxy agents.

mcqs.question: What was the ultimate standard in practice before SNMP Management?
mcqs.explanation: OSI (Open System Interconnection) is a management standard adopted ISO (International Standards Organization). OSI was the ultimate standard used for network management; later SNMP got started as an interim set of specifications that later developed into a management standard.

mcqs.question: SMI and MIB are the two parts of _______ model of SNMP.
mcqs.explanation: Structured Management Information (SMI) and Management Information Base (MIB) are the two modules of SNMP Information model. It is used for monitoring and controlling network devices across the network.

mcqs.question: Internet was developed from _______ with the advent of UNIX and the popularization of client-server architecture.
mcqs.explanation: ARPANET was developed into Internet. In 1984 the name ARPANET was dropped and the name ‘Internet’ was adopted. It was developed after the arrival of UNIX and client-server architecture. Internet is limited to TCP/IP network.

mcqs.question: Which protocol is used for transporting SNMP messages?
mcqs.explanation: SNMP management uses UDP (User Datagram Protocol) for the transfer of SNMP messages. UDP port 161 is used for receiving requests sent by SNMP managers.

mcqs.question: In the SNMP architecture ____________ is a system that collects and transmits local device information.
mcqs.explanation: SNMP architecture comprises of Manager, Agent and Network Management station. A SNMP agent does the function of responding to requests and queries and also trapping problems. It also collects and transmits device information.

mcqs.question: What feature differentiates SNMPv3 from SNMPv1 and SNMPv2?

options.a: a) It has improved error handling process
options.b: b) It provides a common medium for network devices to share management information
options.c: c) It has enhanced security features
options.d: d) It has improvements in performance and manager-to-manager communication

mcqs.answer: c) It has enhanced security features
mcqs.explanation: SNMPv1 and SNMPv2 have poor security. Network administrators used Telnet and SSH for security purposes in SNMPv1 and SNMPv2. Later SNMPv3 was developed. It was almost similar to SNMPv1 and SNMPv2 except for its added security features. SNMPv3 mainly focuses on security and administration.

mcqs.question: _______ is a SNMP PDU used for sending requests to retrieve the value of a variable.
mcqs.explanation: There are in total seven SNMP PDUs. GetRequest is an SNMP PDU that helps in requesting for a value of a variable or a list of variables to be retrieved.

links.context: This set of Computer Network Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “SNMP Operations”.

mcqs.question: ________ types of messages are sent from the agent to the manager.
mcqs.explanation: It is very necessary to report problems occurring in a network to its respective network manager. Thus SNMP Trap messages are defined as alert messages that are sent to the network manager by the agent. This helps the network manager to take necessary actions on time.

mcqs.question: What is the significance of the GET operation in SNMP?

options.a: a) It helps in receiving unsolicited messages
options.b: b) It is used for altering data variables
options.c: c) It is used to retrieve SNMP object variables
options.d: d) It is used for monitoring traffic

mcqs.answer: c) It is used to retrieve SNMP object variables
mcqs.explanation: In Simple Network Management Protocol (SNMP) GET operations are used for retrieving SNMP object variables. GET, GETNEXT, GETBULK etc. are some of the SNMP message PDUs used for retrieving SNMP object variables.

mcqs.question: SNMP can be considered as a synchronous type of protocol.
mcqs.explanation: SNMP is an asynchronous type of protocol. It means that messages are sent only when a problem is reported. This is a disadvantage.

mcqs.question: In SNMP, objects are retrieved using ________ convention.
mcqs.explanation: Lexicographic, Numerical, Collation and Alphabetical are conventional ways of arranging alphabets or objects in an order. Thus in SNMP we use Lexicographic convention for retrieval of objects.

mcqs.question: A manager cannot belong to multiple communities.
mcqs.explanation: Security in SNMP is managed by defining community, and only members belonging to the same community can communicate with each other. A manager can belong to multiple communities and can manage multiple domains.

mcqs.question: SNMP Trap messages comprise of three types of traps, those are_______, _______ and _______
mcqs.explanation: SNMP Traps are alert messages used to notify the manager or central device of any significant event. There are three types of traps- generic-trap, specific-trap, and time-stamp. These types are application specific.

mcqs.question: Why SNMP messages are exchanged using a connectionless UDP transport protocol?

options.a: a) In order to be consistent with the complexity of the SNMP model
options.b: b) In order to reduce traffic
options.c: c) In order to make the process slower
options.d: d) In order to use a heavyweight mechanism for exchanging messages

mcqs.answer: b) In order to reduce traffic
mcqs.explanation: SNMP messages are exchanged using a connectionless UDP transport protocol in order to reduce traffic. However the mechanisms of SNMP are suitable for a variety of protocols.

mcqs.question: In RFC 1157 the entities residing in management stations and network elements are called SNMP ___________ entities.
mcqs.explanation: RFC 1157 specifies the implementation of Simple Network Management Protocol. Thus entities residing in management stations and network elements are called SNMP application entities.

mcqs.question: A pairing of SNMP MIB views with an SNMP access code is called a _________
mcqs.explanation: The pairing of the two entities is called SNMP community. A management agent may be permitted to view only a subset of the network element’s managed objects. This is called the community MIB view. In addition to MIB view, each community name is also assigned an SNMP access mode, either READ-ONLY or READ-WRITE. A pairing of SNMP MIB views with an SNMP access code is called a community profile.

mcqs.question: Specific-trap cannot be generated when an enterprise-specific trap is not present.
mcqs.explanation: There are three types of SNMP Traps. Those are generic-trap, specific-trap, and time-stamp. The specific-trap is a specific code and is generated even when an enterprise-specific trap is not present.

mcqs.question: ____________ is a management tool that can capture packets going across a transmission medium.
mcqs.explanation: Sniffer is a packet sniffing tool. It is a management tool that sniffs or captures data flowing through the computer network in real time. Whereas Server, Router and Bridge are network components that have totally different applications.

links.context: This set of Computer Network Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “SNMPv2 Protocol”.

mcqs.question: An ASN.1 macro _______ is used to define an information module.
mcqs.explanation: The SMI in SNMPv2 is divided into three parts – module definitions, object definitions and notification definitions. MODULE-IDENTITY macro in ASN.1 is used to describe semantics of the information module.

mcqs.question: What is the significance of Textual convention?

options.a: a) It helps in defining new data types
options.b: b) It defines a minimum set of capabilities
options.c: c) It communicates with SNMPv2 manager over the UDP transport layer
options.d: d) It helps in improving the security function of SNMPv2

mcqs.answer: a) It helps in defining new data types
mcqs.explanation: Textual Conventions are designed to help define new data types. They are also intended to make the semantics consistent and clear for humans.

mcqs.question: A/An ________ message is generated by a manager application and is transmitted to another manager application.
mcqs.explanation: Inform-request is a message generated by manager. It is sent using a session. As mentioned above, the receiving manager application responds with a response message. This set of communication messages is a powerful enhancement in SNMPv2, since it makes network management systems interoperable.

mcqs.question: _________ speeds up the get-next-request process and is especially useful to retrieve data from tables.
mcqs.explanation: The Bulk Data Transfer Message has the ability to request and receive bulk data using the get-bulk message. This speeds up the get-next-request process and is especially useful to retrieve data from tables.

mcqs.question: SNMPv2 is backward compatible with SNMPv1.
mcqs.explanation: The most significant changes that were introduced in SNMPv2 were to improve the security function that SNMPv1 lacked. There are significant differences between the two versions of SNMP, and unfortunately version 2 is not backward compatible with version 1.

mcqs.question: In Textual Convention ________ clause is applicable to situations where the underlying primitive type is either INTEGER or OCTET STRING.
mcqs.explanation: The DISPLAY-HINT clause in TEXTUAL-CONVENTION is optional. It gives a hint of the value of an instance of an object. It is applicable to situations where the underlying primitive type is either INTEGER or OCTET STRING.

mcqs.question: In SNMPv2, there are total of six protocol operations.
mcqs.explanation: The messages, get-request, get-next-request, set-request, get-response, GetBulkRequest, InformRequest, and get-bulk-request are the seven protocol operations in SNMPv2.

mcqs.question: ________ describes how to use a subset of ASN.1 to define an information module.
mcqs.explanation: There are three kinds of information modules that are defined in SNMPV2. They are MIB modules, compliance statements for MIB modules, and capability statements for agent implementations. Structured Management Information (SMI) describes how to use a subset of ASN.1 to define an information module.

mcqs.question: The conformance information, which encompasses both compliance and agent capabilities, is covered in _________
mcqs.explanation: The information on SNMPv2 has been split into three parts. MIB modules for SNMv2 are covered in RFC 1902. The textual conventions to be used to describe MIB modules have been formalized in RFC 1903. RFC 1904 defines SNMPv2 conformance statements for the implementation of network management standards.

mcqs.question: Module definitions in SNMPv2 are equivalent to trap in SNMPv1.
mcqs.explanation: Notification in SMlv2 is equivalent to trap in SNMPv2. In SNMPv1, trap is formally specified by an ASN.1 macro, TRAP-TYPE.

links.context: This set of Computer Network Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “SNMPv3 Features”.

mcqs.question: Security is provided by SNMPv3 using _______ and _______ of data packets over the network.
mcqs.explanation: SNMPv3 has advanced features and improved security features as compared to other versions. It authenticates and encrypts data packets sent over the network.

mcqs.question: SNMPv3 is an internet management standard defined by ________
mcqs.explanation: IETF (Internet Engineering Task Force) is an open standards organization. It defines Internet Management standards such as SNMPv3.

mcqs.question: Which protocol is used for managing network devices in the SNMP framework?
mcqs.explanation: Transmission Control Protocol and Internet Protocol are the protocols used for managing two or more network devices in a network. It is a reliable protocol and helps in recovering after a network failure.

mcqs.question: Among the SNMPv3 RFCs _________ describes architecture of SNMP Management Frameworks.
mcqs.explanation: RFC 3411 presents an overview of SNMPv3. It defines a vocabulary for describing SNMP Management Frameworks and an architecture for describing the major portions of SNMP Management Frameworks. Whereas RFC 3410 provides an overview of SNMPv3 Framework, RFC 3412 describes message processing and dispatching for SNMP messages and RFC 3413 describes SNMPv3 applications.

mcqs.question: SNMPv1 and SNMPv2 messages cannot be formalized and are not compatible with the SNMPv3 system.
mcqs.explanation: An SNMP engine is defined with explicit subsystems that include dispatch and message-processing functions. It manages all three versions of SNMP to coexist in a management entity. This formalizes the various messages that have been in use in the earlier versions.

mcqs.question: How does SNMPv3 prevent malicious modification of messages?

options.a: a) By providing a special key to the user that is based on Engine ID
options.b: b) By converting MIB modules from SNMPv3 to SNMPv1 or SNMPv2
options.d: d) By reordering and time delaying of message streams

mcqs.answer: d) By reordering and time delaying of message streams
mcqs.explanation: SNMPv3 has enhanced security features as compared to SNMPv1 and SNMPv2. The configuration can be set remotely with secured communication that protects against the modification of information and masquerades by using encryption schemes. It also tries to ensure against malicious modification of messages by reordering and time delaying of message streams.

mcqs.question: In an SNMP engine, there is more than one dispatcher that can handle only a single version of SNMP.
mcqs.explanation: In a dispatch subsystem of SNMP architecture, there is only one dispatcher in an SNMP engine and it can handle multiple versions of SNMP messages.

mcqs.question: The access control subsystem provides access _________ service.
mcqs.explanation: There are three subsystems in SNMPv3 architecture. They are Dispatcher Subsystem, Message Processing Subsystem and Security and Access Control Subsystem. The access control subsystem provides access to authorization service.

mcqs.question: What is the function of an XML interpreter in SNMPv3 Architecture?

options.a: a) It converts the XML PDU to SNMP PDU
options.b: b) It converts SNMP PDU to XML
options.c: c) It encrypts the PDU converted to XML
options.d: d) It deciphers the PDU encrypted in XML

mcqs.answer: a) It converts the XML PDU to SNMP PDU
mcqs.explanation: An SNMP security management architecture that is policy-based is composed of several components. XML interpreter converts the XML PDU to SNMP PDU. It then transfers these SNMP PDUs to other applications.

mcqs.question: A _________ application is used to generate get-request, get-next-request, get-bulk, and set-request messages.
mcqs.explanation: SNMPv3 formally defines five types of applications. They are command generator, command responder, notification originator, notification receiver, and proxy forwarder. A command generator application is used to generate get-request, get-next-request, get-bulk, and set-request messages.

links.context: This set of Computer Network Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “SNMPv3 User-based Security Model”.

mcqs.question: The ability to control what data a user can read or write is known as ________
mcqs.explanation: Access control is a security technique that allows users the access and also grants them the permission to make necessary changes in the data. The access control is divided majorly into two types. Those are: 1) Physical access control and 2) Logical access control.

mcqs.question: Five type of threats exist to network management information while it is being transported from one management entity to another.
mcqs.explanation: Four type of threats exist to network management information while it is being transported from one management entity to another. Those are: (1) modification of information, (2) masquerade, (3) message stream modification, and (4) disclosure.

mcqs.question: The use of ______ involves defining collections of data, groups of users of the data, and access statements.
mcqs.explanation: In SNMPv3 access control has been made more flexible and secure. VACM defines a set of services that an application in an agent can use to validate command requests and notification receivers. Thus, VACM defines collections of data, groups of users of the data, and access statements.

mcqs.question: An _________ SNMP engine is responsible for the accuracy of the time-stamp and a unique SNMP engine ID in each message.
mcqs.explanation: An SNMP engine that acts in the role of an agent is the designated authoritative SNMP engine. An authoritative SNMP engine is responsible for the accuracy of the time-stamp and a unique SNMP engine ID in each message.

mcqs.question: What is the function of Masquerade in SNMPv3 security threats?

options.a: a) Some unauthorized user may modify the contents of the message while it is in transit
options.b: b) The message stream could be monitored by an unauthorized person by eavesdropping
options.c: c) An unauthorized user sends information to another assuming the identity of an authorized user
options.d: d) An authorized user is denied service by a management entity

mcqs.answer: c) An unauthorized user sends information to another assuming the identity of an authorized user
mcqs.explanation: Masquerade is when an unauthorized user sends information to another assuming the identity of an authorized user. This can be done by changing the originating address. Using the masquerade and modification of information, an unauthorized user can perform an operation on a management entity, which he or she is not permitted to do. The SNMP set operation should be protected against this attack.

mcqs.question: Two algorithms are recommended in SNMPv3 for developing the key from the password. They are ______  and ______

options.b: b) Block Cipher Algorithm, Stream Cipher Algorithm

mcqs.explanation: HMAC-MDS-96 and HMACSHA-96 are the two algorithms recommended in SNMPv3 for developing the key from the password. The first letter in the designation stands fur the cryptographic hash function (H) used for generating the Message Access Code (MAC). The second part in the designation is the bashing algorithm used, the first one being the MDS hashing algorithm, and the second one the SHA-1 hashing algorithm to generate MAC.

mcqs.question: The first eight octets of the 24-octet privacy key are used to create the DES key.
mcqs.explanation: The first eight octets of the 16-octet privacy key are used to create the DES key. The DES key is only 56 bits long and hence the least significant bit of each octet in the privacy key is discarded.

mcqs.question: One important function of an NMS as a user is the discovery of agents in the network. This is accomplished by generating a ______ message.
mcqs.explanation: The discovery of agents in the agents by NMS, in the network is accomplished by generating a Request message with a security level of no-authentication and no-privacy, a user name of “initial,” an authoritative SNMP engine ID of zero length, and a varBind list that is empty.

mcqs.question: What is the function of the access policy?

options.a: a) It permits the operation of changes and modification in a key
options.b: b) It provides a common medium for network devices to share management information
options.c: c) It has enhanced security features
options.d: d) It determines the access rights to objects as read-view, write-view, and notify-view

mcqs.answer: d) It determines the access rights to objects as read-view, write-view, and notify-view
mcqs.explanation: The access policy determines the access rights to objects as read-view, write-view, and notify-view. For a given groupName, contextName, securityModel and securityLevel, that group’s access rights are defined by either the combination of the three views or not-accessible.

mcqs.question: An SNMP _______ is a collection of management information accessible by an SNMP entity.
mcqs.explanation: There are five elements of VACM model. They are: (I) groups, (2) security level (3) contexts, (4) MIB views and view families, and (5) access policy. An SNMP context is a collection of management information accessible by an SNMP entity. An SNMP entity has access to potentially more than one context. Each SNMP engine has a context table that lists the locally available contexts by contextName.

links.context: This set of Computer Network Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Remote Network Monitoring”.

mcqs.question: SNMPv1 set the foundation for monitoring a network remotely from a centralized network operations center (NOC) and performing _____________ management.
mcqs.explanation: SNPv1 provides active management tasks. It sets the foundation for performing fault and configuration management. In configuration management, network operations are controlled whereas in fault management network problems are solved.

mcqs.question: The characterization of the performance of a computer network is ___________ in nature.
mcqs.explanation: The characterization of the performance of a computer network is statistical in nature. This led to the logical step of measuring the statistics of important parameters in the network from the NOC and the development of remote monitoring (RMON) specifications.

mcqs.question: The process where a tool “sniffs” every packet that is going across a local area network (LAN), opens it and analyzes it is a __________ operation.
mcqs.explanation: SNMP messages going across the network between a manager and an agent is examined. This is accomplished by using a tool that “sniffs” every packet that is going across a local area network (LAN), opens it and analyzes it. Thus it is a passive operation.

mcqs.question: In RMON, individual segments can be monitored on a discrete basis thus providing better control.
mcqs.explanation: In RMON, individual segments can be monitored on a continuous basis. This characteristic of RMON proves to be more advantageous. It helps in faster detection and reporting of faults to the Network Management System. It provides better control of the network.

mcqs.question: What is the probe?

options.a: a) It is a device that deals with the storage of management information
options.b: b) It is a tool that addresses operation and administration of functional model
options.c: c) It is a device that does the function of monitoring the packets
options.d: d) It is a device that provides complete model for network management

mcqs.answer: c) It is a device that does the function of monitoring the packets
mcqs.explanation: When SNMP messages going across the network between a manager and an agent is analyzed then it’s called network monitoring or probing. Here the messages are not modified. This is achieved using a device called network monitor or probe.

mcqs.question: If both the components of a probe i.e 1) Physical object and 2) Processor are at different places geographically then it is a local probe.
mcqs.explanation: Physical object and Processor are the two components of probe in a Network. When these two components operate from the same place, geographically then the probe is called as the local probe.

mcqs.question: What is RMON?

options.a: a) It is a processor that analyzes the data
options.b: b) It is remote monitoring of the network using a probe
options.c: c) It is a device that is connected to the transmission medium
options.d: d) It is a module that collects data from the remotely monitored networks

mcqs.answer: b) It is remote monitoring of the network using a probe
mcqs.explanation: Remote Monitoring Network can be defined as the standard that is used to gather information from a network for monitoring purpose. This gathering of information from a network can be accomplished using devices such as monitors, consoles, probes etc. Thus it is useful in remote monitoring of the network using a probe.

mcqs.question: Which of the following is an advantage of RMON?

options.a: a) It reduces the necessity of agents in the network to be visible at all times to the NMS
options.b: b) It provides additional support for vendor specific MIB modules
options.c: c) It is an excellent medium for fault management
options.d: d) It is widely accepted and works good for device monitoring

mcqs.answer: a) It reduces the necessity of agents in the network to be visible at all times to the NMS
mcqs.explanation: The use of RMON devices has several advantages. The overall benefits of implementing RMON technology in a network are higher network availability for users and greater productivity for administrators. One of the advantages of RMON is that it reduces the necessity of agents in the network to be visible at all times to the NMS. Other options convey the advantages of SNMP that are different from those of RMON.

mcqs.question: Standards need not be established for common syntax and semantics for the use of RMON devices.
mcqs.explanation: For a network configuration system to work successfully, several conditions need to be met. Network components are made by different vendors. Even the RMON devices may be from different vendors. Thus, just as in the communication of network management information, standards need to be established for common syntax and semantics for the use of RMON devices.

mcqs.question: A token-ring probe monitors the token-ring ______________
mcqs.explanation: A device that monitors the data packets in a network is called a network monitor or a probe. In a fiber-distributed data interface (FDDI) backbone network with a local Ethernet LAN. There are two remote LANs, one a token-ring LAN and another, an FDDl LAN, connected to the backbone network. Thus a token-ring probe monitors the token-ring LAN.

links.context: This set of Computer Network Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “RMON1”.

mcqs.question: RMON1 was initially defined for data link level parameters of ________ LAN.
mcqs.explanation: RMON1 was initially defined for data link level parameters of Ethernet LAN. It was then extended to token-ring LAN.

mcqs.question: The commercial probes were fast enough to measure the packets traversing an FDDl ring.
mcqs.explanation: To replace commercial tools special tools were developed for the study. The commercial probes were not fast enough to measure the packets traversing an FDDl ring. Hence, a promiscuous mode of counting the packets (function of a probe) was developed to measure traffic on the gateway.

mcqs.question: _________ is used to define the ports to be monitored in a particular statistics, host, or matrix collection.
mcqs.explanation: The portSelect group addresses port selection. It is used to define the ports to be monitored in a particular statistics, host, or matrix collection. It contains two tables. The portSelGrpTable controls the set-up of ports and ATM connection selection criteria used on behalf of any collection associated with entries in this table, such as atmHostTable. The portSelTable is then used to control the set-up of selection criteria for a single ATM port.

mcqs.question: RMON probe is a type of probe measures traffic at the cell _________ level only.
mcqs.explanation: The RMON probe is an embedded probe with access to the switch fabric. However, this type of probe measures traffic at the cell header level only.

mcqs.question: At the data link sub layer, ATM RMON measures packets and frames.
mcqs.explanation: At the data link sub layer, ATM RMON measures cells instead of packets or frames, and provides cell-based per-host and per-conversation traffic statistics.

mcqs.question: The ________ is an inventory of the protocols that the probe can monitor.
mcqs.explanation: The protocol directory group is an inventory of the protocols that the probe can monitor. The capability of the probe can be altered by reconfiguring the protocolDirTable. The protocols range from the data link control layer to the application layer.

mcqs.question: RMON1 dealt primarily with data associated with the OSI ______ layer.
mcqs.explanation: RMON1 is covered by RFC 1757 for Ethernet LAN and RFC 1513. RMON in general and RMON1 specifically, performs numerous functions at the data link layer. Hence it can be said that RMON1 majorly dealt with data that associated with data-link layer of the OSI model.

mcqs.question: Which of the following groups can generate a report of the top N protocol conversation?
mcqs.explanation: The application layer functions are grouped into two groups, the application-layer host group and the application layer matrix group. They both calculate traffic by protocol units and use their respective control tables in the network-layer host group and the network-layer matrix group. The application-layer matrix group can also generate a report of the top N protocol conversations.

mcqs.question: The ATM RMON MIB is under the experimental node of the _____ lnternet MIB.
mcqs.explanation: There are four different collection perspectives that are possible for ATM RMON. The ATM RMON MIB is under the experimental node of the IETF lnternet MIB.

mcqs.question: In RMON1 Ethernet groups, what are the Statistics group?

options.a: a) It contains information about the hosts on the network
options.b: b) It contains statistics measured by the probe for each monitored Ethernet interface on a device
options.c: c) It is a periodic statistical sampling of data from various types of networks
options.d: d) It periodically takes statistical samples on specified variables in the probe and compares them with the pre-configured threshold stored in the probe

mcqs.answer: b) It contains statistics measured by the probe for each monitored Ethernet interface on a device
mcqs.explanation: There are nine RMON1 common and Ethernet groups. The statistics group contains statistics measured by the probe for each monitored Ethernet interface on a device. The etherStatsTable in this group has an entry for each interface. Data include statistics on packet types, size, and errors. It also provides the capability to gather statistics on the collision of the Ethernet segment.

title: 15. MCQ on Network Management Tools, Systems, and Engineering
