links.context: This set of Computer Network Management Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “System Utilities for Management”.

mcqs.question: Network Status Tools lists some of the network status-monitoring tools that are available in the ___________ and ___________ environments.
mcqs.explanation: A significant amount of network management can be done using the operating system (OS) utilities and some freely downloadable SNMP tools. Network Status Tools lists some of the network status-monitoring tools that are available in the Linux/UNIX and Microsoft Windows (XP and Vista) environments.

mcqs.question: The command ________ on a UNIX system is used to assign an address to a network interface or to configure network interface-parameters.
mcqs.explanation: The command ifconfig on a UNIX system is used to assign an address to a network interface or to configure network interface- parameters. Usually, one needs to be a super-user (su) in UNIX to set interface parameters.

mcqs.question: How can we obtain IP address using nslookup?

options.a: a) By repeatedly executing ping with a large repeat count
options.b: b) By calculating the difference in round-trip times for different packet sizes from each end of the link
options.c: c) By sending the query to the local domain name server
options.d: d) By finding all the hosts on a local area network (LAN) using a broadcast ping on the LAN

mcqs.answer: d) By finding all the hosts on a local area network (LAN) using a broadcast ping on the LAN
mcqs.explanation: Dig or nslookup can help when one wants to find all the hosts on a local area network (LAN). This can be done using a broadcast ping on the LAN. We need to know the IP address to execute this command, which we may not know. However, if we know a host name on the LAN, we could obtain the IP address using nslookup.

mcqs.question: A _________ provides the service of locating IP addresses.
mcqs.explanation: The UNIX commands, nslookup, host and dig, are useful for obtaining names and addresses on hosts and domain name servers. A domain name server provides the service of locating IP addresses.

mcqs.question: A frequent use of ‘dig’ is when an execution of a command on a remote station fails.
mcqs.explanation: One of the most basic tools is ping (Packet lnternet Groper). A frequent use of it is when an execution of a command on a remote station fails. As one of the first diagnostics, we want to ensure that the connection exists, for which the ping utility is executed to the remote host. If it fails, then there is a problem with the link. If it passes, then the trouble is with either the application or something else.

mcqs.question: The bing utility determines the _______ of a link.
mcqs.explanation: Bing (point to point bandwidth ping) is a using useful tool, heavily based on ping. The bing utility determines the raw throughput of a link by calculating the difference in round-trip times for different packet sizes from each end of the link.

mcqs.question: An SNMP MIB browser is a highly complex tool.
mcqs.explanation: SNMP MIB tools are of three types: (I) SNMP MIB browser; (2) a set of SNMP command-line tools; and (3) Linux/FreeBSD-based tool. An SNMP MIB browser is a user-friendly tool that can be accessed from public software libraries or commercially purchased.

mcqs.question: ________ communicates with a network object using the SNMP get-request message.
mcqs.explanation: SNMP Get Command communicates with a network object using the SNMP get-request message. The host may be either a host name or an IP address. If the SNMP agent resides on the host with the matching community name, it responds with a get-response message returning the value of the objectID.

mcqs.question: What is the function of an SNMP Sniff tool?

options.a: a) It captures SNMP packets going across the segment and stores them for later analysis
options.b: b) It displays the entire MIB tree supported by the agent
options.c: c) It is useful to get the values of variables in table
options.d: d) It sends the SNMP set-request message and receives the get-response command

mcqs.answer: a) It captures SNMP packets going across the segment and stores them for later analysis
mcqs.explanation: The SNMP Sniff Tool snmpsniff; is similar to the tcpdump tool and is implemented in Linux/FreeBSD environment. It captures SNMP packets going across the segment and stores them for later analysis.

mcqs.question: Although protocol analyzer could be used for the analysis of any line, it is primarily used in the _______ environment.
mcqs.explanation: The protocol analyzer is a powerful and versatile network management tool. Although it could be used for the analysis of any line, its primary use is in the LAN environment. It consists of a data capture device that is attached to a LAN.

links.context: This set of Computer Network Management Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Network Statistics Measurement Systems”.

mcqs.question: One key aspect of network management is _______ management.
mcqs.explanation: There are various network management methods such as fault management, security management, accounting management, address management etc. Traffic management is also a major aspect of network management.

mcqs.question: ________ is the best tool to gather network statistics.
mcqs.explanation: One of the best ways to gather network statistics is to capture packets traversing network segments or across node interfaces in a promiscuous mode. We have learned that protocol analyzers do just that. Thus, they are good tools to gather network statistics.

mcqs.question: The RMON1 MIB groups and tables are used to gather statistics at the ________ in Ethernet and token ring LANs.
mcqs.explanation: The RMON1 MIB groups and tables are used to gather statistics at the data link layer in Ethernet and token ring LANs. The RMON2 MIB groups and tables define parameters for higher-layer statistics.

mcqs.question: How are load statistics in an IP network obtained?

options.a: a) It is obtained using NetMetrix LanProbe and a protocol analyzer
options.b: b) It is obtained by measuring traffic in a segment directly
options.c: c) It is obtained by measuring IP packets at the network layer level
options.d: d) It is obtained by presenting similar statistical data on traffic

mcqs.answer: c) It is obtained by measuring IP packets at the network layer level
mcqs.explanation: Load statistics in an IP network can also be obtained by measuring IP packets at the network layer level. The entities in the network layer host and the network layer matrix groups in RMON2 MIB can be used for this measurement

mcqs.question: Data for traffic monitoring can be sampled at the data link layer using the RMON2 SMI history group.
mcqs.explanation: The source, the destination, and the source-destination pair are used for traffic load monitoring. Data for traffic monitoring can be sampled at the data link layer using the RMON1 MIB history group and not using the RMON2 SMI group which has a totally different application.

mcqs.question: Traffic load information can be used for _______ management of real-time and non-real-time traffic.
mcqs.explanation: We can obtain the traffic load for different applications such as file transfer (FTP), Web data (HTTP), and news groups (NNTP). This information can be used for bandwidth management of real-time and non-real-time traffic.

mcqs.question: In SMI, a record is an unordered collection of elements of different types.
mcqs.explanation: SMI provides a very simple view of the network. Every element is completely defined by a set of variables, which may take on a limited number of data types. These include scalar or primitive types and three structured or constructed types (arrays, records, and sets). A record is an ordered collection of elements of different types, with each element referred to by name.

mcqs.question: The SNMP protocol allows a/an ______ to get or set the value of a variable.
mcqs.explanation: A record can be defined to bold related variables pertaining to one part of an NE (in one subtree of the MIB). Another record with identical fields but different names must be defined The SNMP protocol allows a manager to get or set the value of a variable.

mcqs.question: Derived rate measure is constant and precise.
mcqs.explanation: A rate is a derived measure. The derived measure of rate is imprecise and gives different results depending on the averaging interval. Different managers may require different averaging intervals and even one manager may require different averaging intervals at different times.

mcqs.question: What is the use of RMON MIB?

options.a: a) It is very useful in localizing the source of route failure
options.b: b) It provides a convenient mechanism to build network-monitoring systems
options.c: c) It analyzes the data for the required statistics
options.d: d) It is used for obtaining port information of different applications and sessions

mcqs.answer: b) It provides a convenient mechanism to build network-monitoring systems
mcqs.explanation: The RMON MIB that we studied in, along with the SNMP communication protocol provides a convenient mechanism to build network-monitoring systems.

links.context: This set of Computer Network Management Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “NMS Design”.

mcqs.question: In ______________ is controlled by a configuring file, which sets a number of parameters.
mcqs.explanation: The strategy used in the discovery process is to check a range of IP addresses for the presence of Network Elements using the simplest and most generic possible techniques. Thus Configuring Discovery is a discovery process. Here the discovery is controlled by a configuring file, which sets a number of parameters.

mcqs.question: Which of the following is one of the services provided by Telecom Network presently?
mcqs.explanation: The characteristics of telecom or large enterprise network helps in providing a variety of services. Telecom networks today provide a variety of: services including voice, data, Internet, and video.

mcqs.question: _____________ is a type of network that has a large number of manageable devices including switches, servers, routers, base stations, multiplexers, etc.
mcqs.explanation: Scalability is important to the life network administrator. Typically, such a network has a large number of manageable devices including switches, servers, routers, base stations, multiplexers, etc.

mcqs.question: It is not important for the NMS to have an easy-to-use user interface.
mcqs.explanation: Network administration is faced with two challenges: one is the increasing complexity of network equipment and the other the high attrition rate of technical staff. Hence, it is important for the NMS to have an easy-to-use user interface (UI). Increasingly, this is graphical (GU!) and may be browser based.

mcqs.question: Much of network management is performed remotely from the ____________
mcqs.explanation: Much of network management Is performed remotely from the Network Operations Center (NOC). However, there are users who need to use the NMS from other locations. Subscribers may be located anywhere in the network.

mcqs.question: One of the important functions of the Performance Manager (PM) is data collection.
mcqs.explanation: One of the important functions of the Performance Manager (PM) is data collection. This is done by periodically polling NEs for relevant performance data. The other important function of the PM is data analysis. Reports are generated to identify bottlenecks, analyze trends in order to plan capacity upgrades, and to tune the network and systems. Anomalies in performance trends may also indicate security problems such as denial of service attack.

mcqs.question: The MDB contains the ___________ information of each managed object.
mcqs.explanation: A number of modules are grouped around a central managed object database (MDB). The MDB contains the configuration information of each managed object.

mcqs.question: What is the function of a Fault Manager (FM)?

options.a: a) It receives notifications of events in Network Elements
options.b: b) It provides additional support for vendor specific MIB modules
options.c: c) It is responsible for automatically detecting the presence of new Network Elements in the network
options.d: d) It provides secure access to Network Elements

mcqs.answer: a) It receives notifications of events in Network Elements
mcqs.explanation: The Fault. Manager (FM) receives notifications of events in NEs. It may also infer faults by analysis of data. For instance, by comparing measured throughput. on a link with link capacity, it can detect a congestion fault. The FM notifies the operator through various means such as text, graphics, audio, etc. It may also take automatic corrective action to resolve a fault.

mcqs.question: Hubs are usually manageable by SNMP and are included in topology discovery.
mcqs.explanation: The topology of a network depends on the interconnections between routers and switches. Hubs are usually not SNMP-manageable and are not included in topology discovery.

mcqs.question: Functional modules communicate with the Network Elements through the _________
mcqs.explanation: Functional modules communicate with the NEs through the protocol layer. This layer may support a number of common management protocols such as various versions of SNMP, XML, CMIP, and also proprietary protocols.

links.context: This set of Computer Network Management Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Telecommunication Network Management (TMN)”.

mcqs.question: System operators interface with the operations systems using ________
mcqs.explanation: The interfaces associated with various functions and services have been standardized in the TMN model. System operators interface with the operations systems using workstations.

mcqs.question: What is the use of a trunk system in the Operations Support System for Network Transmission?

options.a: a) It is used for planning and implementation of adequate facilities for traffic to be handled without being blocked
options.b: b) It is used to change operations system, as it is also used to control the network and network elements
options.c: c) It is used to monitor the loss and signal-to-noise ratio in the trunk transmission system in Bell System
options.d: d) It is used to make network management system interoperable

mcqs.answer: c) It is used to monitor the loss and signal-to-noise ratio in the trunk transmission system in Bell System
mcqs.explanation: The trunk test system is used to monitor the loss and signal-to-noise ratio in the trunk transmission system in Bell System. A trunk is a logical entity linking two switching offices.

mcqs.question: TMN had been developed based on ________ management principles.
mcqs.explanation: TMN is necessary to extend the private and proprietary, but well-developed network management systems, and make them interoperable. It is to be kept in mind that TMN had been developed based on OSI management principles.

mcqs.question: It is not necessary for a trunk to meet the minimum criteria set for quality control.
mcqs.explanation: A logical entity, used to link two switching offices is known as Trunk. Each and every trunk in the network is inspected for their quality check. It is extremely necessary that a trunk qualifies the minimum criteria set for quality control otherwise they are removed from service.

mcqs.question: The operations systems in the OAMP of telecommunication network are part of the telecommunications network management activities and fall under the ________ function of the network management.
mcqs.explanation: The role of operations systems in the OAMP of telecommunication network is crucial. They are part of the telecommunications network management activities and fall under the performance management function of the network management that is defined under the OSI model.

mcqs.question: In function blocks, when a Web browser interfaces with a Web-based management system it is accessing an x-reference point.
mcqs.explanation: The function blocks in are connected with interfaces designated by x, q3, qx and f. When a Web browser interfaces with a Web-based management system it is accessing an f-reference point. When a network management system automatically creates a trouble ticket in a trouble tracking system, it is communicating via an x-reference point.

mcqs.question: The TMN _______ provides an interface between human personnel and TMN activities.
mcqs.explanation: M.3010 defines TMN architecture made up of five function blocks: operations systems function, network element function (NBF), mediation function (Mf), workstation function (WSF), and Q-adapter function (QAF). The TMN WSF provides an interface between human personnel and TMN activities. More specifically, this function addresses the presentation aspect.

mcqs.question: An interface between a management agent embedded in a network element and a network management system will be a _____ reference point.
mcqs.explanation: The function blocks in are connected with interfaces designated by x, q3, qx, and f. These are called TMN service interfaces or simply, TNM interfaces. An interface between a management agent embedded in a network element and a network management system will be a q3 reference point.

mcqs.question: Information models specified by SNMP and OSI management deal with the management of network managers.
mcqs.explanation: Information models specified by SNMP and OSI management deal with the management of network elements. The TMN information model has been used in specific technology such as ATM and SDH/SONET.

mcqs.question: ________ is used by the performance management application to gather traffic statistics, by the configuration system to discover and delete network elements, and by the fault management system to gather errored-seconds on unstable elements.
mcqs.explanation: Function blocks are designed to be non-overlapping. This could be used by the performance management application to gather traffic statistics, by the configuration system to discover and delete network elements, and by the fault management system to gather errored-seconds on unstable elements.
